  • Assist stakeholders in understanding data, analytical findings, reporting requirements, and dashboard outputs.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.

About the role:

Security Operations Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day monitoring, analysis, and investigation of security threats across enterprise systems and networks. The role triages and responds to security alerts and incidents, working both independently and in collaboration with senior analysts on known or suspected threats.

The analyst supports incident response, threat intelligence, and forensic analysis activities in alignment with established security best practices and control frameworks. This includes identifying anomalies, escalating issues as appropriate, and contributing to the improvement of detection and response processes.

Security Operations Analysts may work shifts and participate in on-call rotations to support global operations and ensure continuous security monitoring coverage.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark:

  • Develop and deliver security reports and metrics to support operational awareness and leadership decision-making.

  • Identify and support mitigation of information security risks, including evaluating projects and initiatives for alignment with security requirements, policies, and standards.

  • Monitor systems and security telemetry for violations, vulnerabilities, and anomalous activity.

  • Analyze and apply threat intelligence to enhance detection, response, and situational awareness.

  • Identify and support onboarding and validation of security telemetry to ensure effective detection and visibility.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support incident response, remediation, and security improvements.

  • Assist in the evaluation and selection of security technologies and solutions to support detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed:

  • A degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field is desirable.

  • 5-7 years of experience in security operations or related disciplines. with demonstrated expertise in security analysis and incident response.

  • Working knowledge of security controls including access control, authentication, encryption, system integrity, and logging as applied to security monitoring and detection.

  • Experience with security operations including monitoring, incident response, and incident management procedures, with the ability to investigate, escalate, and respond to security events.

  • Ability to develop, modify, and maintain threat detection rules within SIEM platforms, including tuning alerts and improving detection fidelity.

  • Understanding of security telemetry, including log collection and ingestion (e.g., syslog, Windows Event Forwarding, ELK), normalization, and data quality considerations to support effective detection and visibility.

  • Strong knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), identity systems (e.g., Active Directory), and network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS) as they relate to security monitoring and investigation.

  • Experience with endpoint, network, and host-based security tools including EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, vulnerability scanners, and host-based detection/prevention systems.

  • Ability to analyze and correlate data across multiple security and telemetry sources to identify patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and potential security threats.

  • Experience applying security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to map adversary behaviors and support detection and response development.

  • Experience with malware analysis, network forensics, and digital forensics concepts and tools; reverse engineering skills are a plus.

  • Ability to assess security threats and implement timely mitigations under pressure.

  • Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent to support automation, analysis, and response activities.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Experience with security platforms and tools including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence tools (e.g., Google SecOps/Chronicle, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne Singularity, Tanium Threat Response, Recorded Future).

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring and native security services across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or OCI is a plus.

  • Familiarity with security-focused frameworks, methodologies, and best practices for detection, response, and vulnerability management is a plus.

  • Ability to analyze and apply threat intelligence to support detection, investigation, and response activities.

  • Experience developing or working with automated response workflows and playbooks (SOAR).

  • Advanced professional role requiring strong technical proficiency in security operations, detection, and incident response. Works independently with minimal supervision on complex investigations, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues, identify risks, and escalate appropriately.

  • Serves as a senior technical resource for the team, providing guidance, mentorship, and cross-training to junior analysts while promoting consistent standards for analysis, detection, and response. Contributes to the development and continuous improvement of detection logic, alert tuning, and response playbooks.

  • Effectively communicates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborates with peers on complex issues to enhance team capability. May assist in coordinating and tracking tasks for junior team members.

Newell Brands is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® - and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Position Summary

The Maintenance AI Technology Training Specialist is responsible for developing, delivering and continuously improving enterprise-wide training programs that accelerate adoption of digital maintenance tools, mobile technology and AI-supported troubleshooting across Newell Brands manufacturing sites globally.

Building on deep, hands-on maintenance expertise, this individual designs curricula tailored to adult learners on the shop floor and delivers instruction in person and remotely across North American and international sites. As the enterprise subject-matter authority on digital maintenance practices, the Global Training Lead partners with technicians, maintenance leaders and ERA/IT teams to drive measurable improvements in equipment uptime, work order quality and first-time-fix rates.

Responsibilities:

Curriculum Design & Adult Learning

  • Design, develop and maintain a structured maintenance digitization curriculum — including course outlines, learning objectives, assessments and job aids — grounded in adult learning principles (e.g., experiential, competency-based instruction).
  • Create and update quick-reference guides, e-learning modules and blended learning materials that translate complex digital tool workflows into practical, shop-floor-ready instruction.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve training content based on learner feedback, adoption metrics and evolving tool capabilities.
  • Adapt delivery formats and instructional approaches to diverse learner populations, including frontline technicians, lead technicians and maintenance supervisors.

Training Delivery — In Person & Remote

  • Deliver instructor-led training on-site at manufacturing facilities globally, including hands-on, shift-integrated coaching sessions.
  • Facilitate virtual instructor-led training via video conferencing platform for remote sites and follow-up reinforcement sessions.
  • Provide real-time floor coaching to reinforce skills immediately after formal training, bridging the gap between classroom instruction and day-to-day practice.

Global Travel & Site Support

  • Travel globally (estimated 50% annually) to support site deployments, conduct in-person training and assess adoption health — including travel internationally as the program expands.
  • Serve as the on-site training authority during go-live periods, providing sustained presence and support through the critical adoption window.
  • Develop site-specific training plans that account for shift schedules, language considerations and local maintenance practices.

Digital & AI Tool Enablement

  • Train maintenance teams on tablets, mobile devices, CMMS platforms, digital work order workflows and AI-supported diagnostic tools, including image-based troubleshooting.
  • Serve as a primary liaison between ERA, IT, and site maintenance teams to ensure training content reflects current tool configurations and release updates.
  • Identify capability gaps and design targeted intervention programs to close them efficiently.

Adoption Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track leading training indicators — learner completion, assessment scores, tool utilization rates and work order quality metrics — to demonstrate training effectiveness.
  • Provide structured feedback to ERA and enterprise product teams on usability, tool gaps and enhancement opportunities observed during training delivery.
  • Capture and codify lessons learned, success stories and site-specific best practices to build a reusable training knowledge base scalable across the enterprise.
  • Contribute to regional and global maintenance excellence forums to share best practices and inform program direction.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Required: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or trade school credential strongly preferred.
  • Required: 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, with demonstrated proficiency in equipment troubleshooting and end-to-end maintenance processes.
  • Required: 2+ years of experience training or teaching adult learners in a manufacturing, technical or industrial setting — including development of training materials and facilitation of structured learning sessions.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience developing and executing training curricula or instructional programs specifically designed for adult learners (e.g., competency-based training, on-the-job training frameworks, blended learning programs).

Delivery & Communication Skills

  • Proven ability to deliver effective instruction both in person on the plant floor and via remote/virtual platform.
  • Strong facilitation skills — able to engage mixed-experience audiences, manage group dynamics and adapt delivery pace and depth in real time.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical guidance accessible to frontline technicians.
  • Comfort presenting to and collaborating with maintenance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Technical & Digital Proficiency

  • Proficiency with tablets, mobile devices and standard productivity applications; ability to quickly learn and teach new digital tools.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled diagnostic tools or strong aptitude and curiosity for rapidly adopting emerging technologies.

Travel & Mobility

  • Ability and willingness to travel globally — approximately 50% annually — to manufacturing sites across North America and internationally as the program expands.
  • Valid passport or ability to obtain one.

Leadership & Professional Capabilities

  • Proven track record of driving change in a peer or coaching capacity — influencing adoption without formal authority.

Instacart's Strategic Finance team partners across the business to drive disciplined growth and long-term value creation. Within this group, Consolidation is responsible for being the aggregated source of truth for how Instacart performs and where it's headed. As Director, Strategic Finance – Consolidation, you will own this responsibility and sit at the center of our financial ecosystem — integrating inputs from Accounting, other parts of StratFin, Business Operations teams, Investor Relations, and more — into one coherent, reconciled, and forward-looking view of the company.

This is a high-visibility role at the heart of Instacart's financial governance. Reporting to the Vice President of Investor Relations and Strategic Finance, you will be the architect of our consolidated P&L forecast, our long-range financial model, and the financial narratives that inform our Board, investors, and executive team. As Instacart continues to mature as a public company, this function is foundational to how we govern the business and tell our financial story.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous financial operator and natural integrator — someone who sees the forest, not just the trees. You know how to land the quarter while simultaneously anticipating what's around short-, medium-, and long-term corners. You consolidate narratives and key business insights across teams into a single, coherent point of view. You earn the trust of senior stakeholders through consistently high-quality work, lead a high-performing team, and set the bar for what great looks like.

Own the consolidated financial view

  • The monthly and quarterly close cycle runs on time and at executive-quality standards, with variance analysis and management reporting packages that connect results to business drivers — not just numbers on a page.
  • A GAAP and non-GAAP long-range financial model (5-year) reflects current strategy and updated assumptions, with scenario analysis that helps leadership anticipate what's around the corner.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Team

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

What You'll Do

  • Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
  • Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
  • Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
  • Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
  • Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
  • Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
  • Identify and support new creator and developer categories
  • Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
  • Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
  • Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
  • Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
  • Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
  • Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
  • Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
  • Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
  • Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.
  • Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams make crisp investment decisions in ambiguous spaces.

jobs.description:
About 2070 Health

2070 Health is India's first venture studio, established by W Health Ventures. It builds healthcare companies from scratch by identifying gaps in the market that remain unserved. Unlike an accelerator, the studio is directly involved in idea generation, daily operations, and strategic decisions as each company grows. Companies established in the last 24 months include Elevate Now, Nivaan Care, Reveal Healthtech, BabyMD, Everhope Oncology, and Everbright Health.

About the role

The Growth and Outreach role is responsible for running the studio's outbound engine end to end. This is not a standard SDR position. The role covers AI-assisted outreach across email and LinkedIn, with ownership of every component: data, sending infrastructure, copy, testing, and results.

This is a non-client-facing role. It builds and runs the outbound engine. Booked conversations and any client, customer, or investor relationships are handled by the research and investment teams, not by this role.

End-to-end experience required

This role requires hands-on experience across the entire outbound workflow. Candidates who have owned only individual parts of the process, with other functions or agencies handling the remainder, are not suited to this position. The workflow, owned end to end, includes the following.

  • Data sourcing. Building target lists from a defined ICP rather than inherited or purchased lists.
  • Data enrichment and hygiene. Verifying, deduplicating, and completing records.
  • Sending infrastructure. Setting up domains, mailboxes, warmup, and sending limits, whether directly or through a platform such as Instantly, with a clear understanding of how each functions.
  • Deliverability. Diagnosing and resolving bounces, spam placement, and declines in reply rates.
  • Copywriting. Producing cold emails that generate replies from a US audience, without reliance on mail-merge.
  • Campaign execution. Running multi-touch sequences across email and LinkedIn, including follow-ups.
  • Measurement and optimization. Tracking performance, running tests, and improving reply rates and meetings booked.

This experience must be current and hands-on, not drawn from a role held several years ago.

Scope of work

The role supports two use cases.

1. New thesis research and early sales. Working with the research team to test new company ideas in healthcare. This involves identifying the experts, clinicians, operators, and potential customers worth engaging, running outreach to book those conversations, and returning the resulting signal in a form the team can act on.

2. Fund outreach. Expanding the fund's relationships through researched, personalized outreach to downstream investors and potential LPs, including building and maintaining target lists, running sequences, and managing follow-up.

Working model

The role operates on a project basis. Deliverables and timelines are defined at the outset, after which the consultant sets priorities independently and reports progress on an agreed cadence. Performance is measured on outcomes rather than daily activity. The role does not include daily task assignment or supervision.

AI fluency

AI fluency is central to this role. The expectation is practical, demonstrated use rather than familiarity. Relevant capabilities include the following.

  • Researching accounts and personalizing outreach at scale using tools such as Claude, rather than generic templates.
  • Building AI steps into the pipeline, for example Clay AI columns or prompt chains, so that repetitive work is automated.
  • Connecting tools through light automation using Zapier, n8n, or custom scripts.
  • Evaluating new tools as they become available and retaining those that add value.
  • Primary tools: Apollo, Clay, Smartlead or Instantly, and a CRM such as HubSpot.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience, the majority in hands-on cold outreach that booked meetings, with campaigns run directly by the candidate.
  • A record of owning a metric such as reply rate, meetings booked, or pipeline, with accountability for the outcome rather than task completion.
  • Direct experience at an early-stage company where outreach was owned as a sole function. Additional experience at a larger, more structured organization is an advantage, as it indicates exposure to outreach at scale.
  • Experience running outreach to US prospects, with the ability to write for that audience.
  • Strong written English, producing cold emails that read as though written by a person.
  • The ability to learn quickly, given limited ramp-up time.
  • Healthcare experience is an advantage but not a requirement.

This role is not a fit if

  • Campaign experience is limited to data, sending infrastructure, and copy prepared by others.
  • Daily direction and task management are required to remain productive.
  • Outreach experience is several years old and has since given way to a management role rather than direct execution.
  • Only parts of the workflow described above have been performed, with the remainder to be learned on the job.
  • Experience comes from a large organization in which separate teams owned each stage of the process and only one stage was owned directly.

jobs.title: Co-Founder (m/w/d) für eine neue digitale Plattform
jobs.excerpt: [Bulle & Mensch] ist der deutschsprachige Video-Podcast über das echte Handwerk erfolgreicher Trader und Investoren: Setup, Psyche und der Mensch hinter den Entscheidungen.
jobs.description:
[Bulle & Mensch] ist der deutschsprachige Video-Podcast über das echte Handwerk erfolgreicher Trader und Investoren: Setup, Psyche und der Mensch hinter den Entscheidungen.

Aus dieser Reichweite soll jetzt ein eigenständiges digitales Produkt entstehen, das dieser Community einen exklusiven, kostenpflichtigen Mehrwert bietet. Das Konzept steht, die Zielgruppe ist da - was fehlt, ist jemand, der es unternehmerisch aufzieht: von der ersten Version bis zum tragfähigen Geschäft.

Arbeitsmodell: Remote, Beteiligung/Equity, langfristige Partnerschaft (keine Agenturen, keine klassische Anstellung)

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst den Aufbau dieses digitalen Produkts als Co-Founder, das heißt konkret:

  • Du entwickelst aus der bestehenden Idee ein marktfähiges Angebot: Positionierung, Preismodell, Struktur
  • Du baust die ersten Versionen auf (Plattformwahl, Aufsetzen, erste Mitglieder) und iterierst auf Basis von echtem Feedback
  • Du verantwortest Business Development: Partnerschaften, Vertriebswege, Wachstumshebel
  • Du steuerst das operative Tagesgeschäft rund um das digitale Produkt, inklusive Mitgliederbetreuung und -bindung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Mario und der bestehenden Podcast-Reichweite zusammen, ohne dass das Produkt vom Kernformat ablenkt

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Starkes Verständnis von Business Development: Preismodelle, Zielgruppen, Vertrieb, Skalierung
  • Echtes, belastbares Interesse an Trading und den Finanzmärkten - du musst kein Profi-Trader sein, aber die Szene und ihre Sprache verstehen
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du triffst Entscheidungen, statt auf Freigaben zu warten
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise auch ohne festen Rahmen
  • Optimal: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines digitalen Produkts oder Geschäfts, idealerweise von null an

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Community mit echter Reichweite und Vertrauen als Startbasis, kein Aufbau bei null
  • Direkter Zugang zu Mario und kurze Entscheidungswege, ohne interne Abstimmungsschleifen
  • Echte Mitgestaltung: Du bist Mitgründer, kein Dienstleister
  • Vergütung überwiegend in Form von Anteilen und variablen Boni statt Fixgehalt, Details werden im persönlichen Gespräch besprochen

Du hast Interesse? Bitte schick uns:

  • Eine kurze Vorstellung von dir und deinem gewünschten Starttermin
  • Referenzen oder Beispiele aus einem früheren Produkt- oder Geschäftsaufbau
  • Deine Antworten auf diese drei Fragen:
  1. Was reizt dich an Trading und den Finanzmärkten persönlich?
  2. Wie würdest du in den ersten 90 Tagen vorgehen, um aus einer Idee ein zahlendes Produkt zu machen?
  3. Was war dein bisher größter unternehmerischer Erfolg, und was dein größter Fehlschlag?

Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

CompanyCam is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a small team of PMs focused on CompanyCam’s in-app communication and project organization tools. This is a player-coach role: you'll be hands-on with discovery, roadmap prioritization, and delivery while also coaching your direct reports and building shared strategy across your group. Your team is working on one of CompanyCam's most active product areas right now - an in-platform communications hub that helps field crews coordinate with each other and keep homeowners informed on job progress. If you thrive at the intersection of execution and team leadership, and you're energized by building something that makes real work easier for the people doing it, we’d love to talk to you.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2 Product Managers, fostering their growth while maintaining hands-on involvement in key initiatives
  • Lead discovery efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value for our biggest customers
  • Build and maintain relationships across engineering, data, design, finance, and marketing teams, proactively sharing insights and achieving cross-functional alignment

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

  • Drive growth through comprehensive, end-to-end initiatives that span insight generation, experimental design, and cross-functional execution
  • Launch new features, build new mobile and web experiences, craft product briefs, and define success metrics to ensure we know if we’ve hit the mark with our efforts

What You'll Bring

  • You bring 7+ years of product experience, with at least 2 years of team leadership or mentorship experience
  • You have a proven track record of driving business impact through data-driven experimentation, breaking down complex problems with curiosity and analytical rigor
  • You're a strategic thinker who looks around corners, thinking several steps ahead while maintaining an ability to communicate complex ideas clearly
  • You have strong cross-functional collaboration skills, understanding that impact comes from empowering others rather than doing everything yourself
  • You can balance hands-on execution with team leadership, knowing when to dive deep and when to delegate
  • Your background reflects a blend of analytical depth and product vision – whether you were a data analyst who wanted to build products or a product person with a passion for data
  • You take an AI-forward approach to work, using it as a force multiplier to help you tackle harder problems
  • A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
  • A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

Bonus Points

  • You're familiar with and have used the set of practices outlined in Continuous Discovery Habits by Teresa Torres
  • You've spent some portion of your career developing solutions for in-platform communications
  • Experience in the construction or contractor industry

About The Product Team

We have four principles:

  1. Holistic thinking: We know that nothing exists in a silo at a team, discipline, or feature level
  2. Proactive collaboration: We build context together and encourage synchronous, streamlined work from our colleagues and diversity in problem-solving
  3. Data-driven decision-making: We use first principles and are skeptical so we can get to the right answer to deliver value quickly
  4. Disciplined prioritization: We substantiate the size of the opportunity we're pursuing, ensuring it connects back to the squad’s outcomes and the business’s strategy

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $190,000-$210,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - AWS & APIs-Frontend Integration awareness -México Only
jobs.excerpt: Sobre el rolBuscamos un Backend Engineer hands-on responsable de diseñar, construir y operar servicios backend en producción dentro de un entorno AWS corporativo.
jobs.description:
Sobre el rol

Buscamos un Backend Engineer hands-on responsable de diseñar, construir y operar servicios backend en producción dentro de un entorno AWS corporativo. El eje del rol es el desarrollo backend sólido: APIs bien estructuradas, patrones de diseño aplicados, código seguro y auditable.

El candidato no será responsable del desarrollo frontend, pero sí debe asegurar que los servicios que construya estén correctamente diseñados para ser consumidos por aplicaciones en React/Next: estructuras de respuesta claras, validaciones, contratos de integración y manejo de errores.

La empresa opera bajo lineamientos corporativos estrictos: casa matriz audita el código, existen herramientas automáticas de verificación de calidad y seguridad antes de cada promoción entre ambientes. Se espera que el candidato llegue con buenas prácticas ya internalizadas no como algo a aprender en el trabajo.

Requirements


— Perfil profesional y soft skills —

PERFIL PROFESIONAL

Buscamos a alguien que:

  • Ha tenido responsabilidad directa sobre lo que construye
  • Puede explicar con claridad qué desarrolló, cómo funciona y por qué se diseñó así
  • Ha trabajado en contextos reales (producción, incidentes, presión, ambigüedad)
  • Puede tomar decisiones y avanzar sin depender constantemente de otros
  • Se comunica de forma clara, directa y estructurada

En entrevista, esperamos ver:

  • Explicaciones concretas, no teóricas
  • Forma de pensar estructurada
  • Capacidad de proponer soluciones reales


    — Perfil técnico — MAPA DE SKILLS
  • Indispensable (sin esto no avanza)
    • Backend hands-on en producción
    • APIs REST + seguridad
    • AWS aplicado en producción
    • Patrones de diseño
    • Código limpio y mantenible
    • IaC: conocimiento funcional (entender cómo funciona y cómo impacta el despliegue)
  • Flexible (puede compensar con potencial claro)
    • React / Next (nivel integración, no desarrollo profundo)
    • IaC: desarrollo directo (escribir desde cero)
    • Servicios avanzados de AWS
    • Experiencia en entornos altamente regulados
  • Nice to have
    • Certificación AWS
    • Experiencia en sector financiero
    • Experiencia en entornos corporativos auditados
    • Conocimiento de CI/CD (no ownership completo)


Primer Frente: — BACKEND—

No se requiere que hayas diseñado arquitecturas de empresa completas, pero sí que puedas construir componentes de forma autónoma, tomar decisiones técnicas fundamentadas y entender el impacto de tu código en el sistema completo. No se busca un arquitecto que delega, se busca alguien que ejecuta con criterio.

(Hands-on real)

  • Experiencia desarrollando APIs en producción (Node, Python, C#, Java)
  • Diseño de APIs REST (endpoints, validaciones, manejo de errores)
  • Implementación de autenticación/autorización (JWT, OAuth2 o similar)
  • Manejo de base de datos (SQL y/o NoSQL)
  • Experiencia real ejecutando (no solo diseñando o liderando)

Stack backend

  • C# (.Net) o Node.js o Python como lenguaje principal. No importa cuál, lo que importa es la profundidad.
  • Desarrollo de APIs REST: diseño de recursos, versionamiento, autenticación (JWT, OAuth2), autorización por roles.
  • Manejo de bases de datos relacionales (SQL) e idealmente alguna NoSQL. Queries optimizadas, transacciones, índices.
  • Manejo de errores robusto: respuestas consistentes, logging estructurado, trazabilidad.
  • Pruebas unitarias e integración: no solo saber que existen también saber escribirlas y mantenerlas.

Esperamos identificar en ti:

  • Facilidad para hablar de tus APIs con propiedad de producto: conoces el input, el output, los casos de error, quién lo consume y por qué se diseñó así.
  • Claridad para explicar paso a paso cómo construiste o modificarías un servicio real: desde la definición del endpoint hasta su despliegue en producción.
  • Agilidad cuando se te presenta un escenario técnico: daR una solución concreta sin evadir o desviar el caso.
  • Capacidad para reconoces trade-offs: saber cuándo usar una Lambda vs un contenedor, una BD relacional vs una NoSQL, y poder justificarlo.
  • Transparencia para compartir cuándo has tenido incidentes en producción y poder describir cómo los identificaste, atendiste y previenes.

Buenas prácticas — 'CÓDIGO LIMPIO'

Este punto es crítico. El código es evaluado automáticamente en cada promoción entre ambientes, por lo que es importante contar con buenas prácticas bien consolidadas desde el inicio.

Patrones de diseño — deberás conocer y saber aplicar al menos uno

  • Clean Architecture (también llamada Arquitectura Limpia): separación de capas, dependencias apuntando hacia adentro, dominio independiente de infraestructura.
  • Arquitectura en Capas (Layered / N-tier): presentación, negocio, datos — claramente separados.
  • Arquitectura de Cebolla (Onion Architecture): núcleo de dominio rodeado por capas concéntricas de adaptadores.

Clean code — lo que esperamos ver en tu forma de trabajar
Se espera que puedas explicar cómo estructuras tu código, cómo separas responsabilidades y cómo manejas errores en servicios reales, con ejemplos claros de lo que has construido.

  • Separación clara de responsabilidades: cada clase, función o módulo cumple un propósito específico.
  • Uso de nombres descriptivos que hagan el código fácil de entender sin necesidad de explicaciones adicionales.
  • Lógica de negocio ubicada en las capas correctas (servicios o dominio), no en controladores.
  • Código limpio y mantenible, evitando redundancias o elementos innecesarios.
  • Manejo explícito de errores, con control y trazabilidad adecuados.

Seguridad en código — requerida, no opcional

  • Validación de inputs en backend (no confiar en el frontend para validar).
  • Protección de endpoints: autenticación + autorización correctamente implementada.
  • No hardcodear credenciales, API keys ni secrets en el código — uso de variables de entorno o servicios como AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Conocimiento básico de OWASP Top 10: SQL injection, XSS, broken auth, etc.
  • Logging sin exponer datos sensibles (PII, tokens, passwords).


Segundo Frente: — CLOUD AWS —

AWS es un componente clave del rol.

Se espera experiencia real en producción y entendimiento de cómo el backend vive dentro de un entorno cloud, pero el enfoque principal sigue siendo backend.

Se espera capacidad de explicar cómo ha desplegado servicios, cómo se conectan entre sí y cómo su código impacta el entorno.

Importante que el candidato:

  • Haya trabajado con AWS en producción (no solo teoría)
  • Entienda cómo se despliegan servicios y se promueve código entre ambientes
  • Comprenda cómo su código impacta seguridad, despliegue y operación

Servicios con los que se espera experiencia práctica

  • Lambda: creación, configuración de triggers, conexión con otros servicios, manejo de timeouts y errores.
  • API Gateway: creación de APIs, integración con Lambda, manejo de stages y autorizadores.
  • S3: gestión de objetos, permisos, políticas de acceso, lifecycle rules.
  • DynamoDB o RDS: operaciones CRUD, índices, conexión desde servicios backend.
  • IAM: roles, políticas, principio de menor privilegio — sabe por qué importa y cómo aplicarlo.


    Infraestructura como Código (IaC) — conocimiento funcional obligatorio:
  • Entiende qué es y para qué sirve: no se crean recursos manualmente en consola.
  • Puede leer y entender una plantilla de CloudFormation o un módulo de CDK/Terraform aunque no sea su especialidad.
  • Sabe cómo se declara una Lambda, un API Gateway o un rol IAM en código.
  • Entiende el ciclo: escribir IaC → plan/preview → deploy controlado.


    Seguridad en nube — nivel esperado
    • Entiende buenas prácticas básicas de seguridad al trabajar en AWS
    • Sabe que el acceso entre servicios debe manejarse mediante roles (no credenciales hardcodeadas)
    • Tiene noción de cómo se protegen APIs expuestas
    • Conoce prácticas básicas para manejo seguro de secretos
  • No se requiere especialización en seguridad cloud, pero sí criterio suficiente para desarrollar sin comprometer el entorno.


    Tercer frente: — REACT / NEXT.JS —

    El candidato no desarrollará frontend. Pero sí construirá el backend que lo alimenta. Debe entender suficiente para garantizar que sus servicios funcionen correctamente en integración.

    -Cómo el frontend consume una API- Entiendes qué estructura de respuesta espera, qué headers necesitas, cómo manejar errores HTTP
    -fetch / axios o equivalente:     Sabe cómo se hace una llamada desde frontend — puede diseñar su API pensando en quien la llama.
    -Manejo de estado básico:     Entiendes qué datos guarda el frontend y cuándo necesita refrescarlos desde el backend.
    -Qué es un hook (nivel conceptual): Sabes que el frontend maneja efectos asíncronos
    -Validación de formularios:     Entiendes qué valida el frontend vs qué debe validar el backend (y por qué el backend siempre debe validar).
    -Protección de endpoints consumidos por frontend:     Sabes implementar autenticación/autorización pensando en un cliente React.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.
📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.
🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.
🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
🌎 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
📢 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
📢 Clases de inglés.
🏆 Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.
🏅 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work.

CALSTART does not ask for any fees or personal information such as social security numbers or bank details during the recruitment process.
About Us:

CALSTART is a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been CALSTART’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

About The Role:

​​CALSTART is seeking to fill a Project Manager to join our School Bus Team and support the administration of the Zero Emission School Bus and Infrastructure (ZESBI) Incentive Project—a $500 million initiative that will be implemented over the next several years.

The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation of the ZESBI Incentive Project, supporting efforts under the School Bus Programs Initiative and Market Acceleration activities, as well as engaging with key external stakeholders; including the California Energy Commission (CEC) and the California Air Resources Board (CARB).

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Support School Bus Team to implement Electric School Bus Incentive Projects.
  • Be the liaison and first point of contact for incentive processing team.
  • Be first point of contact for technical elements of the project including data collection, managing lists of approved products and approved vendors.
  • Provide exceptional customer service to zero-emission school bus incentive project applicants while explaining complex processes and requirements.
  • Under direction of the Electric School Bus, Lead Project Manager, support cross-team functionality to administer a seamless joint application (infrastructure and vehicles) process from start to finish.
  • Support synergies between internal school bus and infrastructure funding mechanisms, particularly Standard HVIP, ZESBI, the HVIP Public School Bus Set Aside, and EnergIIZE, in order to articulate a seamless end-user experience for school districts and stakeholders.
  • Support infrastructure and school bus stakeholder industry engagement as it relates to the above synergies and industry momentum more broadly.
  • Work with internal Salesforce team to administer and implement the ZESBI incentive processing portal for applicants and incentive recipients.
  • Work with internal Incentive Processing team to properly process applications, reimbursements, troubleshoot portal issues, etc.
  • Work with other teams and departments within CALSTART to provide assistance to zero emission school bus applicants/incentive recipients and help projects succeed.
  • Under direction of the Electric School Bus, Lead Project Manager, work with state agencies, industry stakeholders, and the above-mentioned team members to execute incentive design, stakeholder engagement, participation and policy implementation, and end-user experience.
  • Monitor applications, incentive agreements, reimbursements, and other documentation
  • Support the development of project SOPs and internal controls for these deliverables, under direction of the Electric School Bus, Lead Project Manager.
  • Under direction of the Electric School Bus, Lead Project Manager, support with client contract schedules, contract deliverables, etc.
  • Leverage expertise to further CALSTART’s reputation in the zero-emission school bus and infrastructure industries.

Qualifications:


    Experience and Knowledge:
  • Years of experience: 3-5 years
  • California or national school bus and/or infrastructure industry knowledge
  • 2-3 years of project management experience
  • Proven ability to synthesize large amounts of information into clear understandable language for stakeholders and other interested parties
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills as well as ability to communicate via presentations and written deliverables
  • Strong ability to meet or exceed deadlines and able to work with minimal supervision
  • Bachelors Degree in Public Administration, Sustainability, Environmental or other related fields or analogous experience
  • Ability to gather and analyze information and problem solve to propose a solution
  • Demonstrated experience using computer applications, including MS Suite, CRM, etc.
  • Experience working on projects that require a high refinement of detail.
  • Experience using both written and verbal means to communicate with other agencies, stakeholders, industry, and the general public.
  • Ability to engage with varied audiences.
  • Experience establishing priorities and balance multiple activities to meet rigorous deadlines.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Two years of experience with designing grant applications, preferably for zero-emission school bus and/or infrastructure related projects.
  • Processing applications and/or reimbursements for zero-emission incentive projects and/or experience with Salesforce.
  • Experience with planning and/or deploying zero-emission school buses and/or supporting infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of the advanced transportation industry, zero-emission vehicles and supporting technology.
We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you.
We're a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

The Opportunity

Lesley University is seeking an adjunct faculty member to supervise an independent study for the doctoral program during the Fall 2026 Term I.

Independent Study Title: Practitioner Review: Organizational Knowledge

Course Description

This course explores institutional and cultural knowledge stewardship through the lens of survivance. Students examine mechanisms for protecting and sustaining collective knowledge, with particular attention to how communities and organizations maintain cultural continuity across generations while navigating change, disruption, displacement, and coloniality. Rather than treating knowledge as a resource to be managed, the course approaches knowledge as a living relationship requiring reciprocity, accountability, and care.

The course models the practices it examines through participatory inquiry, story exchange, collaborative meaning-making, and the co-creation of resources designed to support knowledge stewardship at organizational, institutional, or tribal levels.

Qualities and Capabilities

The independent study will be conducted in accordance with university guidelines for graduate independent studies. A successful candidate will have:

  • A PhD or terminal degree in Education, Literacy, or a closely related field (required)

  • Strong supervisory, teaching, and mentorship skills

Why Lesley

Located in the heart of Cambridge, Massachusetts, Lesley University is highly regarded for its graduate and undergraduate programs in the human arts of education, the arts, and applied social sciences. Lesley fosters a highly creative environment in which innovative ideas thrive, theory is integrated with practice and its 6,400 students and 90,000 alumni are empowered to improve and enrich communities.

Lesley is committed to the ongoing pursuit of strategic diversity initiatives that help to position diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to institutional and academic excellence at Lesley. In doing so, Lesley strives for a campus culture and community that fosters a true sense of belonging for all, provides opportunity for everyone to participate equally and fully in the Lesley experience, and helps to develop each individual's capacity to confidently and competently engage within and across difference. Given an evolving national context and the rapid change in the demographic profile of our country, the University has made a significant commitment to addressing and enhancing its campus climate and diversity capabilities as an institution.

Expressing Interest

A letter of interest, CV/resume, and a statement addressing past and/or potential contributions to diversity, equity, and inclusion through teaching, professional activity, and/or service must be included for full consideration.

At Lesley University we strive for a supportive and equitable environment where people -- regardless of race, ethnicity, color, sex, physical ability, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, neurodiversity, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, veteran or military status, membership in uniformed services, and all other categories protected by applicable state and federal laws -- can participate equally and fully as their true selves in all aspects of university life. Accordingly, the University prohibits discrimination based on these protected categories in any education program or activity that it operates, including in admission and in employment. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout the fabric of our institution. Individuals may submit concerns or questions related to discrimination to the University's Director of Equal Opportunity. Please visit the Office of Equal Opportunity's webpage for the University's entire notice of nondiscrimination and for additional information.

jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a senior-level engineer with experience across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments who can architect scalable solutions, improve operational efficiency through automation, and collaborate across infrastructure, security, development, and platform engineering teams.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Network Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support enterprise-scale cloud and hybrid network infrastructure environments. This role combines deep networking expertise with modern cloud engineering, automation, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code capabilities.

This position requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering capability, and the ability to operate effectively in complex multi-cloud enterprise environments.

Other responsibilities include:

Cloud & Network Architecture

  • Design and support secure, scalable cloud networking solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Engineer hybrid cloud connectivity solutions including VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, and cloud routing architectures
  • Implement and maintain enterprise DNS, load balancing, segmentation, and traffic management solutions
  • Support modernization initiatives involving cloud-native and software-defined networking technologies

Infrastructure Automation & DevOps

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and Ansible
  • Build and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments and automation workflows
  • Develop Python-based automation solutions and API integrations

Kubernetes & Platform Engineering

  • Support Kubernetes platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE environments
  • Assist with Kubernetes networking, ingress, service connectivity, and infrastructure integrations
  • Collaborate with platform engineering and development teams to improve cloud-native operations
  • Support scalable and resilient containerized infrastructure solutions

Security & Operational Excellence

  • Implement cloud networking and infrastructure security best practices
  • Support firewall, segmentation, and access control strategies across cloud and hybrid environments
  • Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
  • Improve operational visibility, reliability, and efficiency through automation and monitoring

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Other duties as assigned

Required skills and experience:

  • 8+ years of enterprise networking and infrastructure engineering experience
  • 5+ years of cloud engineering experience in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP

  • Experience with load balancers, proxies, and traffic management platforms

  • Prior consulting or professional services experience

• Programming Foundation: Introductory knowledge of Python (coursework, bootcamp, or self-study) and a strong eagerness to learn Robot Framework for test automation and orchestration.

  • Ability to learn and apply knowledge from multiple technical domains to solve testing challenges with guidance from senior team members.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with other technologists to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Familiarity with or ability to quickly learn Atlassian JIRA to track work assignments, log defects, and manage test cases.

  • Partner directly with leading research labs, researchers, and university faculty as a trusted technical advisor: develop a keen understanding of their scientific goals and drive joint research projects at supercomputing scale.

  • A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years in the intersection of HPC and AI, running scientific workloads at scale on multi-node GPU systems and applying machine learning to the same problems.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with academic and research stakeholders, and to communicate complex ideas clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences.

  • Action oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and a passionate learner, with excellent organization skills to work in a heavily multi-tasked environment.

  • Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research in computational science in combination with AI.

Job Description:

In Alpine’s Agile software development environment, the Product Owner (PO) is the key role to ensure product priorities and product roadmaps are executed. The PO develops and executes on a vision for the product and is responsible for translating that vision to actions for the scrum teams. The PO collaborates with internal stakeholders including Product Management, Marketing, Support, Operations, and Engineering to ensure that business, quality, and functional goals are met with each product release. The PO is responsible for the design, usability, quality, and delivery of a product or feature. The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and works to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each stage of the development lifecycle. The PO understands both the technical and business side of the product release and is ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.

  • Roadmap Execution & Delivery

    • Translate insights into product requirements and features

    • Validate concepts directly with users and iterate based on feedback

    • Ensure delivered features meet acceptance criteria and customer expectations

    • Support user acceptance testing (UAT), documentation, and release readiness

    • Oversee beta trials with customers to validate product value and usability

About This Role

The Associate Director, Clinical Quality & Compliance (CQC), serves as a strategic quality leader within R&D Quality & Compliance (RDQC), providing oversight, guidance, and expertise to support the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) across Research, Development, and Medical (RD&M).

This role is responsible for driving a culture of quality and compliance through leadership of Vendor Quality Governance activities, Functional Quality Representation (FQR) for clinical studies, quality risk management, investigations, CAPA oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Associate Director partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to proactively identify quality risks, implement sustainable solutions, and ensure compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards.

The incumbent plays a critical role in protecting study participants, preserving scientific integrity, and ensuring the quality and reliability of clinical data throughout the development lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Clinical Quality & Compliance representative for assigned studies, programs, and functional areas, providing expert guidance on quality and compliance matters.

  • Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System by driving quality governance, process enhancement, and compliance initiatives.

  • Lead quality oversight activities for clinical studies and programs, including Study Risk Assessments (SRAs), quality health assessments, trend analyses, and risk mitigation planning.

  • Provide strategic leadership and consultation to study teams and functional stakeholders on GCP requirements, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.

  • Lead and approve investigations related to deviations, non-conformances, protocol compliance concerns, and other GCP-regulated quality events.

  • Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification to ensure sustainable issue resolution and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with vendor quality representatives and internal stakeholders to ensure vendor compliance with global regulations, industry standards, and contractual quality obligations.

  • Support internal audits, sponsor audits, investigator site audits, and regulatory inspections through preparation, risk assessment, response management, and inspection readiness activities.

  • Identify emerging compliance risks and recommend proactive mitigation strategies that strengthen quality performance and organizational readiness.

  • Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.

  • Monitor quality trends and metrics, providing insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and continuous quality improvement.

Who You Are

You are a strategic and collaborative quality professional with deep expertise in clinical development, GCP compliance, and quality systems. You are comfortable operating independently, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and providing practical solutions to complex quality and compliance challenges. You excel in risk-based decision making, foster strong partnerships across functions, and are passionate about advancing a culture of quality that supports both patient safety and business objectives. You bring strong leadership, analytical thinking, and communication skills, along with a commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting quality oversight within clinical development programs and studies.

  • Experience leading investigations, root cause analyses, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification.

  • Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), risk management principles, quality metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, sponsor audits, and internal audit activities.

  • Experience with vendor oversight and Vendor Quality Governance activities.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and effectively collaborate across multiple functions and organizational levels.

  • Ability to independently manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.

  • Clinical trial systems and process expertise required.

Preferred Skills

  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in Life Sciences, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Healthcare, or a related discipline.

  • Regulatory inspection management experience.

  • Experience serving as a Functional Quality Representative (FQR) for clinical studies.

  • Experience with Study Risk Assessments, quality governance frameworks, and quality-by-design methodologies.

  • Experience leading cross-functional quality transformation or process improvement initiatives.

  • Prior leadership, coaching, or mentoring experience strongly preferred.

  • Location within either the Eastern or Central Time Zones strongly preferred.

Our mission to find therapies for neurological and rare diseases is a unique focus within our industry and this shared purpose is what connects us as a team. We work together to overcome obstacles and to follow science. We are resilient as we strive to make an impact on our patients’ lives and on changing the course of medicine. Together, we pioneer. Together, we thrive.

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Folqs to the next level.

What you'll own

  • Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
  • Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research
  • Creative testing: Build and manage a systematic testing pipeline and rapidly identify winning creatives

  • Performance analysis: Make daily decisions around what to scale, iterate, or kill based on CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate, CVR, contribution margin, and other relevant metrics
  • Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend
  • Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency
  • AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What success looks like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

  • Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
  • Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
  • Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
  • Finding new winning angles and audiences
  • Improving conversion rates across the funnel
  • Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system
  • Ultimately, taking Folqs to the next level

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)

  • Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
  • Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
  • Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
  • Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
  • Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
  • Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
  • An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
  • AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
  • Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

Strong bonus points

  • Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands
  • Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels
  • Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads
  • Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
  • Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

Schedule

  • Significant ownership and autonomy

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?
jobs.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior Network engineer:

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will own the design, deployment and day-to-day reliability of the network fabric that connects Hack The Box's data center footprint across the US, EU, Singapore and Australia. Your work directly underpins the platform experience for millions of users running live cyber simulations — low-latency, high-availability networking isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product.

Design and operate production-grade, multi-site network architectures using BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and JunOS, ensuring our data center interconnects are resilient, observable and ready to scale as HTB grows into new regions.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

  • Europe/Greece
  • Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

  • We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
  • In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
  • We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

🍺 The fellowship you’ll be joining:

You will be part of the wider infrastructure team, reporting to the Director of Infrastructure. You will work alongside systems engineers, platform engineers and SREs responsible for bare-metal, virtualization and container platforms. You will also work cross functionally with security operations, product engineering and IT operations

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, JunOS (Juniper QFX/MX), OSPF, Spine-Leaf / IP Fabric, VLANs, VRFs, Linux networking, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus / Grafana, Observability tooling

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior Network Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • Design and implement spine-leaf network architectures across multiple data center sites in the US, EU, Singapore and Australia
  • Operate and troubleshoot BGP (eBGP/iBGP) peering, route policies and prefix filtering in a multi-site environment
  • Build and maintain EVPN-VXLAN overlay fabrics for scalable Layer 2/Layer 3 connectivity across data centers
  • Configure, upgrade and harden Juniper network equipment (QFX, MX series) running JunOS
  • Develop and maintain network automation using Ansible, Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling
  • Establish and improve network monitoring, alerting and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP, streaming telemetry)
  • Plan and execute network capacity upgrades, site bring-ups and hardware refresh cycles
  • Collaborate with the platform/systems engineering team on network requirements for VMware, Kubernetes and Ceph storage clusters
  • Document network designs, runbooks and standard operating procedures for a globally distributed team
  • Participate in on-call rotation for network-related incidents across all regions

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior Network Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in network engineering, with a focus on data center networking
  • Deep hands-on experience with BGP (eBGP/iBGP), including route policies, communities and prefix management across multi-site environments
  • Proven experience designing and operating EVPN-VXLAN fabrics
  • Strong proficiency with JunOS and Juniper switching/routing platforms (QFX, MX series)
  • Solid understanding of spine-leaf / IP fabric architectures, VLANs, VRFs and inter-VLAN routing
  • Experience with network automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, Nornir or similar)
  • Comfortable with Linux networking fundamentals (iptables/nftables, routing, bonding, VXLANs at the host level)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills — ability to methodically diagnose complex, multi-layer issues under pressure
  • Excellent written communication for documenting designs and collaborating in a remote-first environment
  • Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with network operations in a multi-region, multi-continent data center environment
  • Familiarity with Ceph or other distributed storage systems from a network-performance perspective (NVMEoF, RDMA, high-throughput east-west traffic)
  • Exposure to Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins, service meshes, load balancers)
  • JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP or equivalent networking certifications
  • Understanding of Golang for building internal network tooling or automation
  • Experience in a cybersecurity-focused or platform-as-a-service company

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

  • 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
  • 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
  • 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
  • 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior Network Engineer:

  • 25 annual leave days
  • Paid parental leave
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
  • State-of-the-art equipment
  • Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
  • Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior Network Engineer:

  • Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
  • Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
  • Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
  • Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
  • Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
  • Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
  • Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

Hack Your Career, Today. Join us in this epic adventure of cybersecurity at Hack The Box! 🚀🔒💻

At Hack The Box, we are on a quest to find the most exceptional and enthusiastic talent to join our team. Whether or not you consider yourself a gamer, we value what makes you unique and want to know more about you. This job post provides just a glimpse of the incredible gamified experience our business and consumer customers enjoy through our platforms. So, if you're ready to embark on a journey of growth and adventure, we can't wait to meet you!

ABOUT HTB:

Hack The Box is the leading cyber readiness platform for the agentic era, battle-testing and upskilling both humans and AI agents to enhance organizational cyber resilience. Trusted by the Fortune 500, government agencies, and MSSPs, the platform delivers threat-informed learning paths consisting of real-world scenarios in gamified labs and live-fire simulations that build and validate offensive and defensive cyber capabilities. With a loyal community of more than 4 million members and 800+ enterprise customers, Hack The Box empowers teams and intelligent systems alike to strengthen cyber defenses and reduce breach risk effectively.

Rapidly growing its international footprint and reach, Hack The Box is headquartered in the UK, with additional offices in the US, Australia, and Greece.

  • We’re incredibly proud to share that our headquarters in the UK, along with our entities in Greece and the US, have been certified as a Great Place to Work for 4 consecutive years (2023 - 2026).
  • In addition, our Greek entity has been recognized among the Best Workplaces in Greece (4th, 2nd, 3rd, 1st) and Europe (7th, 10th, 73rd) during this period — a testament to our strong culture and commitment to creating an exceptional employee experience!

Take a sneak peek at how it is to be part of HTB. Get more insights about our HTB culture and employee experience by visiting the “about us” section of our site, our career site, and Glassdoor.

As such, we ensure that all job applications are considered solely based on merit, skills, and qualifications.
