jobs.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview :

We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Tamil-speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.

You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services.
  • Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.
  • Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.
  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.
  • Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Tamil and a good command of English.
  • Previous experience in tele sales or sales roles is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.
  • Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.
  • Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to Mid-Market customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is looking for a Senior AI Security Researcher to help define how frontier AI systems, agentic applications, and AI-enabled security automation are tested, attacked, defended, and safely deployed.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior AI Security Researcher to help define how frontier AI systems, agentic applications, and AI-enabled security automation are tested, attacked, defended, and safely deployed. You will build new methods, tools, evaluations, and proofs of concept that help NVIDIA understand and reduce security risk across AI models, AI platforms, autonomous agents, cloud services, developer tooling, and accelerated computing systems!

We are looking for a researcher who can move fluidly from open-ended research questions to application within working systems: someone who can discover novel failure modes, build rigorous evaluation harnesses, prototype adversarial and defensive techniques, and turn findings into practical mitigations for engineering teams. The right person may come from AI security, ML security, malware data science, cyber-defense research, adversarial ML, LLM security, offensive security, threat hunting, or applied security research at scale!

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and answer open-ended AI security research questions that helps NVIDIA understand, measure, and reduce risk in frontier models, agentic systems, AI platforms, and AI-enabled products.

  • Develop practical methods, prototypes, evaluations, or tools that reveal how AI systems can fail under adversarial conditions and how those risks can be mitigated.

  • Explore a range of AI security problems, such as LLM and agent security, adversarial testing, model evaluation, cyber-defense automation, vulnerability discovery, secure deployment, or autonomous response.

  • Translate research into usable outcomes for engineering and security teams, including proof-of-concept demonstrations, benchmarks, technical guidance, mitigations, and secure-by-design recommendations.

  • Collaborate across offensive security, product security, AI research, platform, cloud, and infrastructure teams to connect research insights with NVIDIA's highest-impact security priorities.

  • Help shape NVIDIA's AI-security research strategy by mentoring others, identifying emerging risks, and building repeatable practices for evaluating and defending AI systems.

What We Need to See:

  • 12+ years of experience in AI security, cybersecurity research, applied ML research, offensive security, cyber defense, or related technical fields.

  • Demonstrated record of original research and practical impact, such as deployed security ML systems, AI-security evaluations, CVEs, patents, publications, conference talks, open-source tools, production mitigations, or funded research programs.

  • Hands-on ability to build working research systems in Python and modern ML/data tooling such as PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable platforms.

  • Experience with one or more AI-security areas: LLM security, adversarial ML, model evaluation, agent security, prompt injection, model backdoors, data poisoning, model abuse, secure RAG, synthetic data, or AI-enabled security automation.

  • Strong cybersecurity foundation, including threat modeling, adversary simulation, exploit or vulnerability research, malware analysis, network defense, threat hunting, detection engineering, digital forensics, secure code review, or incident-response automation.

  • Ability to work across ambiguous research problems and practical product constraints, translating findings into prioritized recommendations and measurable security outcomes.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity or a related field.

  • Experience leading AI-security research for major models, AI platforms, security products, or large-scale production systems.

  • A track record of building security ML systems that operate at real-world scale,

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Published work or public technical leadership in AI security, malware data science, adversarial ML, LLM security, cyber-defense automation, or offensive AI.

  • Experience developing benchmarks, challenge datasets, red-team tools, evaluation suites, or simulation environments for AI and security systems.

  • Deep knowledge of attacker tradecraft, including living-off-the-land techniques, supply-chain abuse, application-layer AI attacks, data exfiltration, and abuse of autonomous tooling.

  • Experience with low-level systems security.

  • History of mentoring researchers, winning or leading research programs, filing patents, publishing papers, or speaking at major security and AI venues.

In this role, your research will help NVIDIA build AI systems that are not only powerful, but trustworthy, resilient, and secure. You will work with world-class researchers, engineers, and security teams on problems that matter to NVIDIA's products, customers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 5, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.excerpt: About Avalere HealthUnited by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE.
jobs.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

Avalere Health is seeking a Consultant with experience in health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), real world evidence (RWE) generation, and/or real-world data analytics to join our Evidence & Strategy practice.

You will manage and conduct RWE and HEOR studies, provide research support (including development of study protocol, technical reports, statistical analysis plans, manuscripts, abstracts, etc.), interpret quantitative and qualitative study results and convey the results in lay English to a variety of audiences. A background in healthcare research consulting is preferred.

About the Evidence & Strategy Practice

Avalere Health is a vibrant community of innovative thinkers dedicated to solving the challenges of the healthcare industry. We dig deep into the healthcare system and work closely with clients to develop practical solutions. At Avalere Health, we prize curiosity, resilience, a positive attitude, and an enthusiasm to embrace new challenges. Join us and get ready to make your mark on healthcare!

Avalere’s Evidence & Strategy practice provides exceptional consultation, evidence, and insights on key aspects of healthcare – including patient-centric HEOR, US real world evidence (RWE) studies leveraging claims, EHR, and other data sources, data optimization, quality, shared decision-making, value-based care, and health equity – and to shape strategy for our clients.

Our mission is to improve quality of care, craft data-driven strategies, drive patient-centric outcomes, and ultimately provide the highest value to all our partners, including life sciences companies, payers, providers, and patient advocates. Our work is focused in 3 intersecting strategic pillars: Patient-Centric Value, Evidence & Analytics, and Healthcare Strategy.

What you'll do

  • Apply statistical, epidemiological, and/or econometric expertise to research and client deliverables
  • Collaborate with programmers, statisticians, and other researchers to analyze large US healthcare datasets (e.g., patient or claims data) to uncover insights and inform strategy
  • Create compelling, client-ready presentations and reports that tell a clear and engaging story
  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference materials, and thought leadership
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality outcomes for clients
  • Take ownership of multiple project workstreams, managing budgets, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication with minimal oversight
  • Lead and contribute to client meetings, presenting deliverables and shaping next steps
  • Support day-to-day client engagement, helping to manage expectations and deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Support business development through proposals, contributing to scopes of work, and identifying opportunities for growth within client accounts
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to support the development of junior team members
  • Develop subject matter expertise and contribute as a trusted resource internally and externally
  • Stay up to date with US healthcare trends to bring fresh, relevant perspectives to your work

About you

    Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree (MA/MS or PhD) in a relevant field such as epidemiology, health economics, public health, statistics, or similar.
  • Minimum 4 years’ consulting, healthcare, or pharmaceutical/device industry work experience.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience working with US healthcare data (claims or EHR data highly valued)
  • Experience in HEOR and/or RWE is essential, particularly with observational studies and secondary data sources such as claims, EHR, real-world data, or other observational datasets. Experience managing these studies and engaging directly with clients is also highly valued.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work to tight deadlines.
  • A collaborative mindset and confidence working in cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive, curious approach with a passion for improving healthcare outcomes.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within a life sciences, healthcare, or strategy consulting environment is highly desirable, with a strong understanding of client service, project delivery, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience presenting research results at scientific conferences and/or a record of peer-review publications.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

Experience working with engineering teams and a solid understanding of Agile product development. Strong working knowledge of various low- and high-fidelity prototyping techniques, including the ability to assess which techniques to apply in different scenarios.

Expert with modern design tools (Sketch, InVision, Adobe Suite). Experience coding HTML, CSS, and javascript (will not have to code with this role). Proven experience testing, measuring and refining designs based on customer feedback and market data.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Prompt Designer II to define the overarching prompt architecture strategy, roadmaps, and governance frameworks powering BOLD's consumer-facing career tools. This is a senior leadership position for someone with genuine depth in prompt systems design, model behavior, and cross-functional enablement. You will build the system others work within, establishing frameworks, governance, and quality standards that ensure AI-generated content is consistent, human-sounding, and maintainable at scale.

About this team

As Senior Prompt Designer II, you will sit at the intersection of long-term architectural vision, organizational mentorship, and rigorous data-driven design. You will support Content, Engineering, Data, and Product teams; acting as the expert who bridges creative intent and technical execution, while leading the professionalization of the prompt management function itself.

What you'll do

  • Lead prompt framework design and strategy - defining end-to-end architecture, version control, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment playbooks for distributed teams.
  • Design complex, high-impact prompt systems including multi-agent and chain-of-thought architectures for resume builder flows across global product lines.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data to align prompt strategies with model selection, API cost reduction, performance budgets, and roadmaps.
  • Architect evaluation frameworks and safety guardrails to benchmark LLM outputs globally, minimizing hallucination, bias, and AI-sounding content.
  • Act as the cross-functional prompt design resource; translating requirements from Content, Engineering, Data, Product, and portal teams into production-grade implementations.
  • Spearhead R&D into emerging AI paradigms, evaluate new models and tooling, and provide clear adoption recommendations.

Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, AI & ISV Ecosystem to help define how Dropbox shows up in the next generation of AI-powered work. As AI and productivity platforms rapidly reshape how people create, access, and collaborate around content, this role will lead some of Dropbox’s most important ecosystem marketing opportunities. You will develop joint go-to-market strategies and high-impact programs with strategic technology partners—including OpenAI, Anthropic, and other leading AI and productivity platforms—while unlocking new growth opportunities across Dropbox’s broader integration ecosystem.

You will lead and develop a small team of partner marketers, operating as a true player-coach: setting direction, prioritizing the biggest opportunities, creating the conditions for your team to do their best work, and helping them grow as strategic marketers, while also contributing to hands-on execution. You will also serve as a senior marketing partner across Business Development, Partnerships, Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Communications, turning technical integrations and partnership opportunities into compelling customer stories, differentiated value propositions, and integrated programs that drive adoption, awareness, pipeline, and growth.

This role owns partner-specific go-to-market strategy, joint positioning, integrated activation, evergreen co-marketing, and performance optimization for Dropbox’s priority AI and ISV relationships; partner selection, commercial agreements, product-roadmap decisions, sales execution, and partner-systems administration remain owned by the corresponding Business Development, Product, Sales, and Operations teams.

This role is designed for a strategic builder, creative marketer, and people leader who thrives where technology, partnerships, and go-to-market intersect. You will identify where Dropbox can create disproportionate value across the ecosystem, shape joint strategies with influential external partners, and lead complex initiatives from early opportunity through launch, activation, measurement, and scale.

You will join Dropbox at a pivotal moment as AI changes how people interact with their content and where work gets done. This is an opportunity to help shape Dropbox’s position in the emerging AI ecosystem, work alongside some of the world’s most influential technology companies, build a high-impact team, and create the partner marketing models that will help define Dropbox’s next phase of growth.

AI is already embedded in this workflow. You will use approved AI tools to accelerate partner research, insight synthesis, campaign ideation, content development, launch planning, and performance analysis—and you will help build better AI-enabled workflows for the team while maintaining rigorous human judgment, review, and accountability.

Responsibilities

  • Set the strategy and build the roadmap:Closely partner with Business Development to define the partner strategy, and own Dropbox’s partner marketing strategy across priority AI and ISV partners, translate business and customer priorities into a clear portfolio of bets, and create the roadmap, prioritization criteria, and operating approach needed to execute against them.
  • Personally build and execute high-priority programs: Lead the most strategic and complex partner marketing initiatives from concept through launch and optimization, including developing joint value propositions, campaign briefs, go-to-market plans, content strategies, activation plans, and partner-facing deliverables—not simply directing the work from a distance. This manager personally leads programs that are highly ambiguous, executive-visible, or strategically consequential, while direct reports own defined partner programs end to end.
  • Create an evergreen co-marketing engine: Build repeatable programs that extend strategic partnerships beyond launch moments, including joint campaigns, customer stories, lifecycle activation, events, content, partner amplification, and other motions that drive sustained awareness, adoption, engagement, pipeline, and revenue objectives.
  • Turn strategy into scalable operating mechanisms: Design and implement partner segmentation, reusable launch frameworks and templates, decision rights, operating cadences, measurement approaches, campaign governance, andjoint investment planning that help the team move faster and scale successful programs across the ecosystem.
  • Lead partners and cross-functional execution: Build trusted relationships with strategic partners and work hands-on with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, make tradeoffs, and drive complex programs to completion.
  • Lead, coach, and work alongside the team: Manage and develop partner marketers while remaining close enough to the work to unblock execution, raise the quality bar, coach through difficult partner situations, model strong craft, and step directly into priority programs when senior-level ownership is needed.
  • Build AI-enabled ways of working: Use approved AI tools directly in partner research, synthesis, planning, content development, personalization, and analysis; identify and implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for the team; and maintain clear human review and accountability for strategy, quality, partner commitments, and business outcomes.

Requirement

  • B2B marketing experience: 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in partner, ecosystem, platform, or strategic alliances marketing, with demonstrated ability to set strategy and then personally build the plans, programs, processes, and deliverables required to execute it.
  • Deep partner marketing craft: Demonstrated experience developing joint value propositions, go-to-market strategies, integrated campaigns, launch plans, and evergreen co-marketing programs with technology, SaaS, platform, AI, or ISV partners.
  • Strong execution under ambiguity: Proven ability to take an underdefined opportunity, create structure, determine what needs to be built, and drive work from initial concept through execution, measurement, iteration, and scale.
  • Analytical and data-informed decision-making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize performance data, customer and partner insights, market signals, and qualitative inputs to evaluate opportunities, diagnose performance, make prioritization decisions, and determine what to scale, change, or stop.
  • Exceptional writing, messaging, and communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop, translate, and critically review joint messaging with partners; distill complex product and ecosystem concepts into clear customer value propositions; and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions effectively to senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional influence and player-coach leadership: Experience building trust and driving decisions across partners, Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing while managing and developing high-performing marketers, raising the quality bar, and stepping directly into complex work when senior ownership is needed.
  • AI-enabled operating mindset: Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation to real marketing or business workflows, with the judgment to use AI for leverage while validating outputs and retaining human accountability for strategic decisions, partner relationships, messaging quality, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AI and technology ecosystem experience: Experience working within AI, SaaS, productivity, collaboration, cloud, developer-platform, or other rapidly evolving technology ecosystems and with major strategic technology partners.
  • Zero-to-one program building: Experience creating a new partner marketing program, capability, operating model, or repeatable motion from the ground up rather than inheriting a fully established playbook.
  • Launch-to-evergreen expertise: Experience turning major integrations, announcements, or partner launches into sustained co-marketing programs that continue driving customer and business outcomes after launch.
  • Commercial and measurement fluency: Experience connecting partner marketing programs to adoption, engagement, pipeline, revenue, or other meaningful business outcomes and using performance signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.
  • PLG + SLG experience: Experience using product adoption and customer signals alongside partner and Sales motions to drive user growth, pipeline, expansion, or revenue.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.title: SEO Team Lead
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. This company looks for people who show up as their whole selves, take ownership without being asked twice, and want more responsibility than their current title gives them.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

This company looks for people who show up as their whole selves, take ownership without being asked twice, and want more responsibility than their current title gives them. If that sounds like you, keep reading.
They provide marketing services exclusively to independent professionals and brands in the automotive detailing, paint protection film, ceramic coating, and window tint industries. They are not a general agency. They understand this market's customers, how they search, and what turns a Google search into a booked job.
They currently manage roughly 100 SEO accounts through outside white label vendors, and they are on pace to launch around 225 new client websites a year. That volume is outgrowing what a packaged vendor relationship can give them in quality control, scope flexibility, and client communication. This role exists to change that.
Why This Role Exists Now
SEO, and local SEO specifically, is one of the highest value services they sell and deliver for their clients. Right now, most of that work is executed through outside white label vendors. This hire changes that relationship. They need someone who can run those vendors, evaluate whether their contracts and scopes of work still make sense for the company, and start building the internal team and processes that let them bring the highest value work in house over time.
  • They need more control over quality, scope flexibility, and client communication than a packaged white label model can provide.
  • They need someone who can evaluate their current vendors on their merits: cost, scope, turnaround, and quality, and make a clear recommendation on each.
  • They want an internal SEO leader who can document how the work should be done, train others to do it, and build a department that integrates tightly with web development & support.
AboutThe Role
They are hiring a Director of SEO to own their SEO strategy end to end: local SEO delivery for their small business clients, their growing use of AI in search, and the relationships they currently hold with white label SEO vendors.
You will start executing and advising from week one. In the first 45 to 60 days, you will audit their current white label vendor contracts and performance, and begin identifying and building out a handful of scopes of work they can bring in house, work that either mirrors or improves on what those vendors deliver today, along with the standard operating procedures that make that work repeatable. As you prove out results and judgment, this role is built to grow into leadership over an internal SEO team.
You will also serve as the company’s internal SEO consultant on website development builds, working with their web team early in the build process so new sites launch search ready rather than getting audited and fixed after the fact. This is an advisory role on the web side. They are not asking you to manage web development vendors, only SEO vendors.
You'll Love This Job If...
  • You'd rather own outcomes than tickets; you want to be the person a shop owner's rankings live or die by, and you take that seriously.
  • You're already thinking about how AI search (AI Overviews, LLM citations, zero-click behavior) changes local SEO, and you want a place to actually test that thinking.
  • You can look at content someone else wrote and make it meaningfully better; structurally, not just line edits, without needing to write every word yourself.
  • You want a leadership track, not just a bigger workload. You're motivated by eventually building and running a team, not just doing more of the same work solo.
You'll Dislike This Job If...
  • You want a fully built department, existing SOPs, and someone checking your work daily; none of that exists yet. You're building a chunk of it.
  • You see vendor management or contract review as beneath your role. Evaluating what they are paying for and deciding what to bring in house is core to this job, not a side task.
  • You need certainty about title and comp progression on day one and the growth path is real but earned, not guaranteed on a calendar.
Core Responsibilities
White Label Vendor Oversight and Evaluation
  • Own the working relationship with the company’s current white label SEO vendors: scope, deliverables, turnaround, and quality.
  • Evaluate vendor contracts on their merits, pricing, scope of work, service levels, and exclusivity or termination terms, and provide the company with a clear recommendation on each: keep, renegotiate, or replace.
  • Within a 45 to 60 day span, identify a small set of scopes of work to begin bringing in house, ones that mirror or enhance what their vendors currently deliver, and start building the standard operating procedures that make those scopes repeatable without you personally in the loop on every account.
Local SEO Execution
  • Own Google Business Profile optimization, map pack ranking strategy, and on-page SEO for a portfolio of small-business (automotive detailing, PPF, tint) client accounts.
  • Diagnose ranking issues and build a prioritized action plan per client, not a generic checklist.
  • Track and report on local ranking movement, map pack visibility, and organic traffic using Ahrefs and other tools.
AI and Answer Engine Optimization Strategy
  • Build and evolve their point of view on how AI Overviews, LLM-based search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and zero-click behavior affect local SEO for small businesses.
  • Translate that strategy into concrete, testable deliverables: content structure, schema/structured data, citation-worthy page formats, not just trend commentary.
  • Track algorithm and AI search changes, and proactively adjust client strategy in advance.
Content Direction & Editing
  • Direct and edit SEO content produced by writers and contractors; briefs, structure, on-page optimization, and quality control before publication.
  • Make sure content ties back to each client's actual ranking and conversion goals, not just word count.
Tools, Reporting & Communication
  • Use Ahrefs (required) for keyword research, competitor analysis, and rank tracking; comfort with Local Falcon or a similar local-rank tool is a plus.
  • Report results in plain language that a shop owner can act on; no jargon, no fluff.
  • Analyze performance trends and translate insights into actionable improvements for future campaigns.
Their Core Values
Before you apply, make sure these land for you. They don't just post values on a wall; they hire, fire, and celebrate based on them.
  • Delivering a WOW experience through service
  • Embrace and drive change
  • Create fun and a hint of weirdness
  • Be adventurous, creative, and open-minded
  • Pursue growth & learning
  • Build a positive team and family spirit
  • Create open and honest relationships built on communication
  • Be humble
  • Never be afraid to ask for help
  • Do it right, or don't do it at all.

What Success Looks LikeFirst 45 Days

  • Completed a full audit of the company’s current white label SEO vendor contracts and performance, with a clear keep, renegotiate, or replace recommendation for each.
  • Identified two to four scopes of work to begin bringing in house, chosen because they mirror or enhance what their vendors currently deliver, and started drafting the standard operating procedure for at least one of them.
  • Independently managing Google Business Profile, map pack, and on page SEO for your assigned client portfolio.
  • Embedded as SEO consultant on at least one active website development build.
First 90 Days
  • Shown measurable ranking or map pack improvement across your client portfolio.
  • Built a documented process for content briefs and editing standards that another writer could follow.
Long-Term
  • Own SEO strategy across all client accounts.
  • Help hire, train, and lead additional SEO team members as the department grows.
  • Help them settle the right long term mix of internal and vendor delivered work, informed by what the first internalized scopes of work actually prove out.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on SEO experience with demonstrable results improving local/SMB rankings (map pack position, GBP visibility, organic traffic); bring examples, not just a resume line.
  • Working knowledge of Ahrefs and or Comparable Tool: keyword research, rank tracking, competitor, and gap analysis.
  • Competence across the range of what modern SEO now covers: traditional technical and on page SEO, local map grid tracking, AI driven SEO, and answer engine optimization. You do not need to be a master of every one of these. You do need to know enough in each to direct the work, judge whether it is good, and recognize when you should bring in outside expertise or hire someone who covers a gap you do not.
  • Experience editing or directing content written by someone else, with a clear point of view on what actually makes SEO content rank and convert.
  • A genuine, current interest in AI-driven search, not just awareness that it exists.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, contract-to-hire structure with limited existing infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to translate high-level SEO strategy into measurable business results.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the impact of SEO to non-technical stakeholders and clients.
​Nice to Have
  • Management or team-lead experience, though we're weighing trajectory and hunger to lead over a management title you've already held.
  • Background working with local or small-business clients, ideally in a service industry.
  • Familiarity with Local Falcon, Google Search Console, or other local-rank and search-performance tools.

Benefits

  • $3800 - $4000 USD/monthly
  • 100% remote from anywhere in Latam

About Doppel

Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management, and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale.

Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader to lead Doppel’s Technical Support & Services function, spanning frontline Customer Support and a team of senior technical resources responsible for advanced escalations, integrations, reporting, and complex customer technical needs.

You will strengthen the path from first-line support through advanced technical resolution, ensuring issues are investigated thoroughly, routed to the right owner, and resolved with minimal unnecessary escalation to Solutions Architecture or Engineering.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can run day-to-day support operations, develop senior technical talent, personally engage in complex escalations, and turn recurring customer work into scalable processes, documentation, automation, and self-service.

What You Will Do

Lead the Organization

  • Lead a blended technical support organization consisting of frontline Support contractors and senior technical-services resources.
  • Own day-to-day performance of the contracted Support team, including staffing, coverage, training, quality, productivity, and adherence to service-level standards.
  • Coach and develop senior technical resources responsible for advanced troubleshooting, integrations, reporting, and complex customer requests.
  • Define clear ownership boundaries across Support, Technical Services, Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, and Engineering.

Improve Technical Service Delivery

  • Evolve frontline Support from an intake-and-routing function into a disciplined first line of validation, investigation, and resolution that completes all documented Support-owned actions before escalation.
  • Establish and enforce escalation-readiness standards requiring clear evidence, investigation findings, completed Support actions, routing rationale, and a specific task before work is handed to Technical Services, Solutions Architecture, Product, or Engineering.
  • Improve routing accuracy and reduce duplicate, premature, or multi-team escalations.

Scale Through Advanced Technical Services

  • Ensure escalations to specialist teams include reproducible evidence, clear expected-versus-actual behavior, actions already taken, and a specific technical request.
  • Identify recurring advanced-support work that can be documented, automated, productized, or shifted down to frontline Support over time.

Scale Through Systems and Knowledge

  • Turn recurring advanced investigations into playbooks, diagnostics, training, automation, and self-service so increasingly more work can be resolved by frontline Support.
  • Improve shared understanding of Doppel’s alert lifecycle, detection pipeline, filtering behavior, integrations, and takedown workflows.

  • Identify high-volume manual work that can be automated, incorporated into the product, or supported through self-service.
  • Improve visibility across customer-facing and engineering workflows, including ownership, status, service levels, and next steps.
  • Use case and escalation data to measure routing quality, Support-owned resolution, specialist escalation volume, and recurring technical demand.
  • Build feedback loops from Support and Technical Services into Product and Engineering to identify systemic defects and recurring customer friction.

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years in technical support / customer engineering / solutions / post-sales.
  • 3+ years managing technical customer-facing teams.
  • Proven track record of managing technical organizations that integrate frontline customer support with advanced escalation and technical services teams.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting, escalation management, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Experience supporting a complex enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, data, or infrastructure product.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering on customer escalations and product improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted support, workflow automation, and customer self-service.
  • Experience working in a rapidly growing startup or similarly dynamic environment.

Why Join Doppel

  • A remote-first culture with flexibility built in.
  • Flexible PTO, comprehensive health benefits, parental leave, and more.
  • A high-growth environment where your work will have immediate impact and visibility.

jobs.excerpt: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators.
jobs.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

Under the supervision of the Senior Vice President and General Counsel, you will play a critical role in the development, maturation, and continuous improvement of Southern New Hampshire University's privacy program. You will be responsible for helping to build, operationalize, and oversee a comprehensive, risk-based privacy program covering the full privacy lifecycle, including the collection, use, sharing, retention, disposal, and protection of personal data that aligns with the University's mission, structure, regulatory and policy requirements, and evolving data environment.

You will partner across academic, administrative, and technology functions to embed privacy compliance into institutional processes, strengthen governance, and enable responsible data use in support of student success and innovation working collaboratively with stakeholders who maintain operational responsibility for data and privacy practices within their respective areas. You will translate regulatory requirements into practical, scalable processes and help establish repeatable, sustainable privacy practices across the institution.

What you will do:

Privacy Program Development & Governance

  • Lead the development, governance, and continuous maturation of a scalable, risk-based university privacy program aligned with institutional priorities, including chairing Privacy Committee(s) and participating in cross-functional working groups.
  • Develop, maintain, and oversee implementation of privacy policies, standards, procedures, and communication strategies in collaboration with stakeholders and governance bodies.
  • Integrate privacy oversight into existing compliance, audit, and risk management processes, and prepare annual privacy program reports for senior leadership.

Risk Assessment & Compliance

  • Lead and continuously improve privacy risk assessment processes, including Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), periodic enterprise-wide privacy risk assessments, and identification of risk mitigation strategies in partnership with the Information Security Management Office (ISMO) and other stakeholders.
  • Assess the effectiveness and maturity of the University's privacy program, including governance, policies, training, and controls, and support remediation and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Oversee third-party privacy assessments, audits, and related remediation activities to ensure alignment with institutional policies and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Support cyber insurance review and selection efforts to strengthen institutional risk mitigation strategies.

Regulatory Monitoring & Implementation

  • Monitor privacy-related regulatory developments and translate legal, regulatory, contractual, and programmatic requirements into actionable institutional practices.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Information Security to align privacy requirements with broader compliance, governance, and risk management frameworks.

Incident Response & Issue Management

  • Support the University's privacy incident response program by coordinating with ISMO, Legal, and other stakeholders to address privacy incidents, inquiries, complaints, and related matters in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and promote consistent processes for identifying, managing, escalating, and resolving privacy-related issues and incidents.

Training, Awareness & Advisory

  • Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive privacy training and awareness program that promotes responsible data stewardship and privacy best practices across the University.
  • Serve as the University's privacy subject matter expert, providing guidance, consultation, and collaboration on privacy requirements, data use, analytics, emerging technologies, and institutional initiatives.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 10 Years of experience in privacy, compliance, risk management or related field (conducting enterprise-wide privacy assessments, privacy governance, chairing committees, privacy program development, etc.)
  • Relevant privacy-related professional certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT, or similar
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly contributing to privacy or compliance programs
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. privacy laws and regulations (e.g., FERPA, GLBA, HIPAA)
  • Familiarity with global privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, "UK GDPR," DPDPA, PIPL, PIPEDA)
  • Experience working in complex, decentralized organizations of significant scale; experience in environments with large volumes of personal data, multi-state or multi-jurisdictional regulatory obligations, or enterprise-wide technology platforms is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills to assess compliance risks and develop appropriate responses
  • Demonstrated sound ethical judgment, discretion with sensitive information,collaboration, adaptability, initiative, diplomacy, and practical learning agility to support privacy, compliance, and institutional risk management responsibilities.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $125,868.00 - $170,293.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

jobs.description:
Job Description: Chief Anti-Money Laundering Officer (Chief AML Officer / CAMLO)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) / Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Board Compliance Committee

Job Summary

The Chief AML Officer (CAMLO) is responsible for leading the organization's Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), and financial crime prevention programs. This role ensures compliance with all applicable AML/CFT regulations and protects the organization from financial crime risks, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and sanctions violations.

The CAMLO serves as the primary authority on AML matters, overseeing policies, systems, investigations, and regulatory engagement to maintain a strong compliance and risk management framework.

Key Responsibilities

1. AML/CFT Strategy & Program Management

Develop and implement enterprise-wide AML/CFT strategies and frameworks

Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and international standards (e.g., FATF guidelines)

Continuously enhance AML programs to address emerging risks

Promote a strong financial crime compliance culture

2. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with AML/CFT laws, regulations, and regulatory expectations

Oversee timely and accurate regulatory reporting (e.g., suspicious transaction reports – STRs)

Act as the primary liaison with regulators and financial intelligence units (FIUs)

Manage regulatory inspections, audits, and reviews

3. Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC)

Oversee KYC, CDD, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) processes

Ensure proper onboarding and monitoring of customers

Implement risk-based customer profiling and segmentation

Monitor high-risk customers and politically exposed persons (PEPs)

4. Transaction Monitoring & Investigations

Oversee transaction monitoring systems and suspicious activity detection

Lead investigations into suspicious transactions and financial crime risks

Ensure timely escalation and reporting of suspicious activities

Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory bodies when required

5. Sanctions & Financial Crime Risk Management

Manage sanctions screening and compliance programs

Ensure adherence to international sanctions regimes

Identify and mitigate financial crime risks across the organization

Implement controls to prevent fraud, bribery, and corruption

6. Policies, Controls & Governance

Develop and maintain AML policies, procedures, and internal controls

Ensure audit readiness and documentation standards

Conduct regular AML risk assessments

Align AML programs with enterprise risk and compliance frameworks

7. Training & Awareness

Develop AML training programs for employees

Promote awareness of AML/CFT obligations and risks

Ensure staff understand policies and reporting requirements

Foster a culture of vigilance and compliance

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop AML and financial crime compliance teams

Establish performance standards and accountability

Drive continuous improvement and innovation in AML practices

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in AML, compliance, financial crime, or risk roles

Proven experience in senior AML leadership roles (e.g., Chief AML Officer, Head of AML, Financial Crime Leader)

Strong background in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and frameworks (e.g., FATF, local regulations)

Expertise in KYC, transaction monitoring, and investigations

Strong analytical and risk assessment skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High ethical standards and attention to detail

Ability to manage complex regulatory environments

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Compliance with AML/CFT regulations

Timeliness and accuracy of STR/SAR filings

Effectiveness of transaction monitoring systems

Reduction in financial crime risks and incidents

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Employee AML training completion and awareness

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Strong relationships with regulators and FIUs

Exposure to regtech and AML technology solutions

Ability to manage complex financial crime risks

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

Job Description Summary


This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

Job description summary

The Data Innovation, Partnerships and Products team, under the Data Products and Foundations pillar within Strategy, Platforms and Transformation, enables improved decision-making at Novar-tis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. The Associate Director, Data Partnerships - Rare Disease will play a critical role in establishing, managing, and strengthening rare disease-focused data partnerships that support the US Commercial organization and advance priority business needs across rare dis-ease brands, customer engagement, patient access, patient finding, and field execution.

This role is responsible for overseeing Novartis’ strategic rare disease data partnerships within SPT to ensure compliance, quality, business relevance, and effective use of external data assets. The Associate Director will bring depth in healthcare and rare disease data, including experience working with or for a data vendor, and will help implement the data partnership strategy, monitor spend and partnership performance, enforce data stewardship practices, and partner with internal teams to identify the most relevant rare disease data sets to support business needs and data-driven decision-making.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement the organization’s rare disease data partnership strategy, including the identification of critical data needs across US Commercial rare disease brands, functions, and priority use cases.
  • Establish, manage, and strengthen strategic rare disease data partnerships with external data providers, platforms, and vendors to maximize the value of external rare disease data assets.
  • Apply deep understanding of rare disease data sources, vendor capabilities, data limitations, patient identification challenges, and fit-for-purpose use cases to guide partnership decisions and business recommendations.
  • Monitor adherence to data quality, security, privacy, and compliance standards for external rare disease data sources, platforms, and vendors, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and internal data management policies.
  • Collaborate with data vendors, business stakeholders, analytics teams, field enablement, access, patient services, and cross-functional rare disease teams to address data quality issues and communicate corresponding changes.
  • Implement oversight mechanisms for external rare disease data partnerships, ensuring compliance with data standards, data-sharing agreements, governance expectations, and internal policies.
  • Implement data stewardship practices across platforms, vendors, and technology solutions to verify that rare disease data is properly managed, governed, and leveraged throughout the partnership lifecycle.
  • Track rare disease data partnerships and spend, provide performance metrics and governance reporting to senior leadership, and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, improved governance, and enhanced collaboration.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand rare disease business needs, recommend relevant data sets, and guide teams on how to extract actionable insights from available data sources.
  • Provide ongoing data advisory support to internal stakeholders, including guidance on recurring deliverables, interpretation of data outputs, data availability, limitations, and appropriate use of rare disease data to support business decisions.

Experience:

Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience establishing and managing rare disease data partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of healthcare and rare disease data, including the strengths, limitations, governance considerations, and business applications of external data assets. Prior experience working with or for a data vendor is strongly preferred, as this role requires the ability to assess vendor capabilities, challenge data assumptions, manage partnership performance, and translate rare disease business needs into practical data solutions. A proven ability to navigate data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, compliance, and small patient population considerations, while building mutually beneficial vendor partnerships is essential. The successful candidate will be committed to continuous improvement in the organization’s rare disease data partnership strategy, leveraging data insights, vendor expertise, and industry trends to strengthen collaboration and maximize the value of external data assets.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience establishing and managing data partnerships, with a strong focus on rare disease, healthcare data, data governance, data management, or related roles.
  • Prior experience working with or for a data vendor, data provider, healthcare data platform, or analytics organization is strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of rare disease data assets, including data sourcing, patient identification, data coverage, refresh cadence, linkage, quality considerations, and fit-for-purpose business use cases.
  • Expert understanding of data partnership principles, frameworks, and best practices, with a proven ability to forge strategic collaborations with external data providers and vendors.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to healthcare data privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of rare disease data.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and change management skills in a complex organizational environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess vendor data quality, identify data gaps, manage risks associated with external data partnerships, and ensure the integrity, security, and quality of shared data.
  • Experience working with IQVIA, Komodo, MMIT, Symphony, Definitive Healthcare, Veeva, claims/EHR data providers, patient services data, specialty pharmacy data, or similar healthcare and rare disease data sources is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate rare disease business needs into data solutions and guide teams in selecting and leveraging the right data sets to support decision-making.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $145,600.00 and $270,400.00 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

jobs.excerpt: The Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Sales Engineer serves as a specialized overlay technical resource responsible for helping enterprise customers modernize their cryptographic infrastructure and prepare for the transition to quantum-safe security.
jobs.description:
The Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Sales Engineer serves as a specialized overlay technical resource responsible for helping enterprise customers modernize their cryptographic infrastructure and prepare for the transition to quantum-safe security. This individual partners with regional Sales Engineers and Account Executives to articulate the technical value of Sectigo's solutions through customer discovery, solution architecture, technical presentations, cryptographic assessments, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and hands-on implementation activities.

This senior level professional possesses exceptional technical, presentation, consulting, and communication skills, enabling strategic customers to assess their current cryptographic environments, understand modernization opportunities, and develop practical adoption strategies that align with their security, compliance, and business objectives.

This is a full-time, remote role, and we’re ideally looking for someone based in the greater London area. The target compensation range is between GBP 120K to 160K, with an 80/20 split between base salary and commission, depending on your experience and background. We also review compensation based on market trends, business needs, and the scope of the territory, so there may be flexibility for the right candidate.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to CISOs, enterprise architects, PKI administrators, security teams, and executive stakeholders, guiding customers through cryptographic modernization and quantum readiness initiatives.
  • Partner with regional Sales Engineers and Account Executives to identify, develop, and support strategic opportunities involving cryptographic modernization, Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), Private PKI, and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).
  • Lead technical discovery engagements to assess customer cryptographic environments, certificate inventories, trust relationships, enterprise PKI architectures, and machine identities.
  • Conduct cryptographic and quantum readiness assessments, helping customers identify risks, prioritize modernization efforts, and develop practical migration strategies.
  • Deliver executive presentations, technical workshops, demonstrations, and architectural reviews that communicate both the immediate and long-term value of Sectigo's security solutions.
  • Provide deep technical guidance during architecture reviews and solution design, ensuring deployments align with customer requirements, security best practices, and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Lead Proof of Concept (PoC) engagements by planning, deploying, configuring, implementing, and validating Sectigo solutions within customer environments.
  • Perform hands-on implementation activities including deployment of discovery technologies, technical integrations, connector configuration, and validation as required during customer engagements.
  • Bridge the gap between technology and business objectives by helping customers understand the value of cryptographic modernization, Certificate Lifecycle Management, and machine identity security.
  • Assist with sales proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Requests for Information (RFIs), ensuring technical accuracy and competitive differentiation.
  • Develop and refine repeatable methodologies, assessment frameworks, technical playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices supporting Sectigo's cryptographic modernization practice.
  • Contribute to the SE Readiness Program by developing subject matter expertise, sharing technical best practices, maintaining current knowledge of assigned solutions, and delivering technical enablement to the field organization.
  • Work closely with Product Management and Engineering, providing field-driven feedback to influence future product capabilities, customer experience, and solution strategy.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Strategic Alliances to support solution adoption, partner enablement, and customer success.
  • Represent Sectigo as a technical thought leader by participating in customer workshops, executive briefings, conferences, webinars, industry events, and technical content development.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment under minimal supervision.
  • Willing to travel regionally and internationally for customer-facing activities, strategic partner engagements, conferences, and internal planning sessions.
  • Participate in strategic alliance initiatives, strengthening relationships with technology partners and strategic customers.
  • Additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned.
  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience is strongly recommended.
  • Microsoft Certified Professional (considered an asset).
  • Linux/Solaris/UNIX System Administration (considered an asset).
  • Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud certification (considered an asset).
  • Security, PKI, or cryptography-related certifications (considered an asset).

Experience:

  • Minimum of 7+ years of industry experience, with at least 3-4 years in an enterprise pre-sales environment.
  • Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Security Architect, or Professional Services Engineer supporting enterprise security, identity, or cloud solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Windows Server platforms, Linux environments, and enterprise authentication technologies.
  • Extensive experience with Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), including automated certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, and lifecycle automation.
  • Expertise establishing and managing Private PKI environments, including Certificate Authorities (CAs), enterprise trust models, and PKI integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), SSL/TLS, X.509 certificates, digital identity, cryptographic principles, and machine identity management.
  • Strong understanding of cryptographic algorithms, key management, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), digital signatures, and enterprise trust architectures.
  • Working knowledge of cryptographic modernization, crypto-agility principles, and Post-Quantum Cryptography concepts is highly desirable.
  • Experience conducting enterprise technical discovery, architecture assessments, and solution design for complex customer environments.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, integrating, and validating enterprise security solutions.
  • Strong cloud experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud (preferred).
  • Proficiency with scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, Bash) and REST APIs (preferred).

Ability and availability to travel:   

  • Must be able to travel more than 35% of the time to the assigned regions and/or territories.

Talents and Desired Qualifications

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to guide customers through long-term cryptographic modernization and security transformation initiatives.
  • Strong consulting skills with the ability to translate complex cryptographic and security concepts into practical business value.
  • Exceptional customer discovery and architectural assessment skills.
  • Deep experience in enterprise solution architecture, technical design, and competitive positioning.
  • Strong hands-on technical capabilities with the ability to deploy, configure, integrate, and validate enterprise security solutions.
  • Ability to influence customer technical strategy while collaborating effectively with regional Sales Engineers, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Strategic Alliances.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, enterprise architects, PKI administrators, and executive leadership.
  • Self-starter with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, capable of managing multiple strategic opportunities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated customer service, account management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Experience selling Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technical solutions.
  • Strong multitasking, troubleshooting, and technical problem-resolution abilities.
  • English language proficiency required. (Other languages are considered an asset.)
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time if required.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Global team. Global reach. Global impact.

At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.

Simplicity at Scale.

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.
