jobs.description:
Job Description
Shield Technology Partners is seeking an experienced Strategic Procurement Lead to build and lead the procurement function across Shield and its portfolio of ShieldCos. Reporting into the Finance team, this role owns vendor relationships, spend management, and procurement operations end to end — from sourcing and negotiation through contract lifecycle management and renewal.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who can bring structure and visibility to spend across a growing multi-entity organization, consolidate purchasing power across the portfolio, and partner closely with Finance, IT, and business leaders to drive measurable savings. This is a build-the-function role: you will define the playbook, not inherit one.
This position is fully remote, with approximately quarterly travel for company meetings, trainings, and team collaboration events.

Key Responsibilities

Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:
• Own and manage commercial strategy and vendor relationships across Shield and ShieldCos, serving as the primary point of contact for strategic suppliers spanning software, hardware, telecom, distribution, and services.
• Drive negotiation for strategic and supplier partnerships, including but not limited to leading contract negotiations, renewals, and terminations and driving favorable pricing, terms, and service levels.
• Build and maintain a centralized contract and renewal calendar with proactive lead time on upcoming renewals.
• Develop and manage a portfolio-wide view of vendor spend, identifying consolidation opportunities and leveraging aggregate purchasing power across ShieldCos.
• Establish procurement policies, approval workflows, and purchasing controls in partnership with Accounting and FP&A, ensuring compliance and consistency across entities.
• Partner with various finance functions to build out a scalable procure-to-pay process for Shield in alignment with best practices and operational efficiency and to assist in budgeting and forecasting.
• Partner with IT and business stakeholders on software and hardware purchasing, license management, and vendor due diligence, including security and data handling review for new vendors.
• Support acquisitions and entity integrations by assessing acquired vendor agreements, identifying overlap, and migrating newly acquired companies onto Shield’s preferred vendor and purchasing framework.
• Manage vendor performance through scorecards, business reviews, and escalation processes.
• Administer and optimize procurement-related systems and workflows, including NetSuite and Ramp.
• Develop KPIs and reporting on spend, savings, and vendor performance for Finance and executive leadership.
• Support budgeting and forecasting cycles with vendor spend analysis and renewal projections.
• Champion AI, automation, analytics, and procurement tools to drive faster decisions, reduce manual effort, and enhance visibility and digital fluencyDefine and implement process improvements that reduce cycle time, deliver efficiency gains, and ensure compliance with policies.


Success in This Role

The successful candidate will bring visibility and discipline to vendor spend across the entire Shield portfolio, build durable vendor partnerships that scale with our acquisition model, and deliver quantifiable savings while maintaining service quality for Shield and ShieldCo teams. jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

To champion a culture of compliance and risk awareness across Sleek, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards globally while driving continuous improvement in our technology and processes.

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

Outcome 1: Know Your Customer (KYC)

  • Review individual KYC exceptions and complete identification/verification within agreed SLAs.
  • Complete corporate shareholder KYC reviews accurately and within agreed SLAs.
  • Ensure all KYC decisions and supporting documentation are complete and appropriately recorded.

Outcome 2: Client Risk Assessment

  • Independently approve low- and medium-risk client cases within SLA.
  • Assess higher-risk cases and provide clear recommendations to the Head of Compliance within SLA.
  • Apply sound judgement and a consistent, risk-based approach when assessing client risk.

Outcome 3: Screening & Monitoring Alerts

  • Review name screening alerts within SLA and accurately determine whether they are false positives or potential true hits requiring escalation.
  • Review transaction monitoring alerts within SLA and determine whether they can be closed or require further investigation.
  • Ensure decisions are appropriately documented and escalated where required.

Outcome 4: Process & Technology Improvement

  • Review existing Compliance policies, tools and processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with the Head of Compliance to improve the efficiency, consistency and effectiveness of compliance operations.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to improve compliance workflows and decision-making.

Must-have experience

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience in a role involving analysis, judgement and/or risk assessment; previous Compliance experience is not strictly required.
  • Experience using AI tools in the workplace, ideally including experimentation with or practical exposure to agentic AI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess information, identify risks and make sound decisions.
  • Ability to work with data and technology and learn new systems quickly.

Must-have attributes

  • Structured thinking & sound judgement – able to assess complex information, identify risks and make well-reasoned decisions.
  • Excellent communication – strong written and spoken English, with the ability to clearly explain decisions and recommendations.
  • Curiosity & humility – naturally curious, open to learning and comfortable challenging their own assumptions.
  • Data-driven & tech savvy – comfortable working with data and adopting new technologies, including AI tools.
  • Ability to persuade and be persuaded – confident in presenting a point of view while remaining open to alternative perspectives.
  • Self-awareness & self-management – understands their strengths and development areas and can manage their work independently in a fast-moving environment.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

One-way Video Interview
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview. This allows us to better understand your skills, experience and interest in Compliance early in the process.

Technical Round
A 90-minute interview with a member of the Hiring Team. This will include a live assessment of your analytical thinking, judgement and ability to work through Compliance-related scenarios.

Behavioural / Soft Skills Round
A 60-minute interview with a member of the Hiring Team, focusing on your recent work situations and how you demonstrate ownership, humility, structured thinking, attention to detail, communication and judgement.

Reference Verification
Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
Project Job Title: Drone Pilot / Surveyor
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Director of Engineering
Travel: Extensive travel to active project sites required

Position Summary
The Drone Pilot / Surveyor is responsible for performing aerial data collection, mapping, surveying support, and construction documentation across utility-scale solar EPC projects. This position utilizes Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), survey equipment, and specialized mapping software to collect accurate field data used to support engineering, estimating, construction, project controls, and site management.
Working within a fast-paced, self-perform EPC construction environment, the Drone Pilot / Surveyor will support projects throughout the construction lifecycle—from existing-condition and preconstruction surveys through earthwork, pile installation, electrical construction, progress tracking, quantity verification, and final project documentation.
The ideal candidate combines strong UAS flight capabilities with practical surveying and construction knowledge and understands how accurate, timely field data directly impacts the successful execution of large-scale solar projects.
Key Responsibilities
  • Plan and conduct UAS/drone flight operations across large utility-scale solar construction sites in accordance with FAA regulations, company procedures, and project requirements.
  • Collect high-resolution aerial imagery and survey data for mapping, topographic surveys, construction progress, inspections, and project documentation.
  • Perform photogrammetry and aerial mapping to produce Ortho mosaics, digital terrain models (DTMs), digital surface models (DSMs), point clouds, and other project deliverables.
  • Support site surveying activities utilizing GPS/GNSS, RTK, robotic total stations, and other survey equipment as required.
  • Establish, verify, and maintain survey control throughout the duration of construction.
  • Support construction layout and verification activities for roads, grading, drainage, equipment pads, pile locations, electrical infrastructure, substations, and other project components.
  • Perform existing-condition and preconstruction aerial surveys to document site conditions prior to mobilization and construction.
  • Conduct routine progress flights to document construction status and provide project teams with current aerial imagery.
  • Assist with earthwork quantity calculations, stockpile measurements, cut/fill analysis, and verification of completed work.
  • Support grading operations by providing accurate surface data and comparing existing conditions against design surfaces.
  • Provide survey and aerial data to support pile installation, tracker/racking construction, module installation, underground electrical systems, inverter/transformer locations, and other solar construction activities.
  • Compare collected field data against IFC drawings, design models, and project specifications to identify potential discrepancies.
  • Support quality control activities by documenting installed conditions and assisting with verification of completed construction.
  • Process and manage drone imagery and survey data using applicable photogrammetry, CAD, GIS, and mapping software.
  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Superintendents, Survey Managers, Engineers, Project Controls, and field personnel to determine survey and aerial data requirements.
  • Maintain accurate flight logs, survey records, field notes, control documentation, and project files.
  • Organize and maintain aerial imagery and survey data so information is readily accessible to project teams.
  • Identify potential site, design, or construction issues through review of aerial and survey data and communicate findings to project leadership.
  • Maintain UAS equipment, batteries, survey instruments, and associated technology in proper working condition.
  • Perform pre-flight inspections and evaluate weather, airspace, site conditions, and potential hazards prior to flight operations.
  • Ensure all UAS operations comply with FAA Part 107 requirements and applicable federal, state, local, client, and company requirements.
  • Coordinate flight activities with project safety and field leadership to ensure drone operations do not interfere with cranes, equipment, electrical work, or other construction activities.
  • Support multiple projects and travel between active construction sites based on project needs.
Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Surveying, Geomatics, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, GIS, or related technical discipline preferred.
  • Current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate required.
  • Previous experience operating drones/UAS for surveying, mapping, engineering, or construction applications.
  • Working knowledge of surveying principles, coordinate systems, elevations, benchmarks, and construction layout.
  • Experience collecting and processing aerial imagery for photogrammetry and mapping applications.
  • Experience with GPS/GNSS and RTK survey equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret civil plans, grading plans, site layouts, construction drawings, and specifications.
  • Understanding of survey control and the importance of horizontal and vertical accuracy in construction applications.
  • Strong computer and data-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in large, active construction environments while coordinating effectively with field personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities across multiple projects.
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively based on project requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience supporting utility-scale solar, renewable energy, heavy civil, power generation, or large-scale EPC construction projects.
  • Experience working for a self-perform EPC or heavy civil contractor.
  • Experience with DJI Enterprise, Trimble, Leica, Topcon, or similar professional UAS and survey equipment.
  • Experience with photogrammetry and mapping platforms such as Pix4D, DroneDeploy, Propeller, Trimble Business Center, or similar applications.
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS, or comparable design/mapping software.
  • Experience creating Ortho mosaics, point clouds, surface models, contour maps, and volumetric reports.
  • Experience performing cut/fill analysis and earthwork quantity verification.
  • Experience with Ground Control Points (GCPs), checkpoints, RTK/PPK workflows, and survey-grade drone mapping.
  • Familiarity with solar site grading, pile installation, tracker systems, access roads, drainage systems, underground electrical collection systems, substations, and related utility-scale solar construction.
  • Surveyor-in-Training (SIT/LSIT) certification or related surveying credentials are a plus but not required.
Physical & Travel Requirements
  • Ability to travel extensively and potentially remain near project sites for extended periods based on construction schedules.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather and environmental conditions.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods while performing field operations.
  • Ability to carry and set up drone, survey, GPS, and related field equipment.
  • Ability to work around heavy construction equipment while maintaining appropriate situational awareness.
  • Ability to wear all required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Must be able to travel by vehicle and air as required

Trility Consulting is seeking a Senior DevSecOps/Cloud Governance Consultant to lead an eight-week engagement focused on establishing practical cloud governance, financial management, and policy standards within a large-scale Azure environment.

This is a hands-on consulting engagement. You'll work directly with the client's cloud infrastructure and IT finance teams to design and implement governance controls that improve cost visibility, resource accountability, policy compliance, and long-term cloud management.

You'll be responsible for turning strategy into working solutions—designing Azure management group structures, developing Azure Policy definitions and initiatives, establishing tagging standards, implementing governance as code with Terraform and GitHub Actions, and identifying actionable opportunities to improve cloud efficiency and financial accountability.

This role requires someone who can comfortably move between technical implementation and executive-level conversations. You'll facilitate discussions with infrastructure, finance, architecture, and data stakeholders; make practical recommendations; document decisions; and coach the client's cloud administrators throughout the engagement.

Trility follows a Coach-and-Contribute model. You'll build alongside the client's team rather than simply delivering recommendations and walking away. The goal is to leave the client with working solutions, clear documentation, reusable patterns, and the knowledge required to independently operate and extend the environment.

This engagement is expected to last approximately eight weeks, with the potential for follow-on work as the client continues its cloud governance and FinOps transformation.

This is a remote 1099 consulting engagement.

What You Will Do

  • Assess existing Azure cloud governance, financial management, resource organization, tagging, and policy practices to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Facilitate cross-functional discussions to define practical cloud tagging standards, including required tags, allowed values, ownership, inheritance, and exception handling.
  • Design and implement an Azure management group hierarchy that supports consistent governance across subscriptions and environments.
  • Design, author, and implement Azure Policy definitions and initiatives to enforce governance, security, compliance, and cost-management standards.
  • Establish governance as code using Terraform and GitHub Actions, including building deployment workflows and promotion processes from the ground up.
  • Implement policies using appropriate effects and rollout strategies, including audit, deny, and exemption approaches.

  • Evaluate Azure cost-management practices, including budgets, alerts, thresholds, approval processes, and cost allocation approaches.
  • Conduct Azure optimization reviews covering resource utilization, right-sizing, reservations and commitments, idle or orphaned resources, region and SKU considerations, and other opportunities to improve cloud efficiency.
  • Quantify optimization opportunities using defensible methodologies and communicate potential financial impact to both technical and finance stakeholders.
  • Develop practical approaches for showback, cost attribution, shared-cost allocation, and resource ownership.
  • Evaluate cloud governance and financial management approaches across additional cloud platforms and provide strategic recommendations where appropriate.
  • Develop reusable governance patterns, implementation guidance, technical standards, and documentation that can be extended beyond the initial engagement.
  • Establish practical processes for maintaining compliance with tagging, policy, governance, and financial management standards over time.
  • Partner closely with client cloud administrators through paired implementation, knowledge sharing, and technical coaching.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and future-state opportunities to technical leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop a FinOps maturity roadmap and prioritized backlog for future phases of the client's cloud governance transformation.
  • Create runbooks, documentation, and handoff materials that enable the client's team to independently operate and extend the solutions delivered during the engagement.

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, platform engineering, FinOps, cloud governance, or related disciplines.

  • Strong understanding of FinOps principles and practical cloud financial management.

  • Experience with Azure Cost Management, billing data, cost allocation, showback/chargeback concepts, and cloud financial reporting.
  • Experience identifying and quantifying cloud optimization opportunities, including right-sizing, idle resources, reservations, commitments, and utilization improvements.
  • Ability to connect technical optimization findings to measurable financial impact and clearly explain the methodology behind the numbers.
  • Strong understanding of how cloud governance and policy controls can be integrated into provisioning, deployment, and operational processes.
  • Ability to assess existing environments, identify gaps, and independently develop practical remediation and implementation plans.

This position evaluates medical records, provides clinical and surgical abstraction for full range of complex and/or multispecialty surgical, procedural and E&M professional services in accordance with nationally recognized coding guidelines. Utilize coding knowledge and expertise to support department projects, validation edits and/or revisions.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Analyzes medical information from medical records. Accurately codes diagnostic and procedural information in accordance with national coding guidelines and appropriate reimbursement requirements. Consults with medical providers to clarify missing or inadequate record information and to determine appropriate diagnostic and procedure codes. Provides thorough, timely and accurate coding in accordance to department specific productivity and quality standards. Codes ICD CM and CPT4 for accurate APC assignment. Addresses National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits as appropriate. Reconciliation of charges as required.

2. Abstracts clinical diagnoses, procedure codes and documents other pertinent information obtained from the medical record into the electronic medical records. Seeks out missing information and creates complete records, including items such as disease and procedure codes, discharge disposition, date of surgery, attending physician, consulting physicians, surgeons and anesthesiologists, and appropriate signatures/authorizations. Refers inconsistent patient treatment information/documentation to coding quality analysts, supervisor or individual department for clarification/additional information for accurate code assignment.

3. Provides quality assurance for medical records. For all assigned records and/or areas assures compliance with coding rules and regulations according to regulatory agencies for state Medicaid plans, Center for Medicare Services (CMS), Office of the Inspector General (OIG) and the Health Care Financing Administration (HCFA), as well as company and applicable professional standards.

4. As assigned, compiles daily and monthly reports; tabulates data from medical records for research or analysis purposes.

5. Able to identify validation edits and revision issues to ensure compliant coding.

6. Recognizes and distinguishes complex diagnoses and procedures and has attention to detail to make needed corrections and ensure accurate coding, reimbursement, and compliance.

7. Works independently under regular supervision. Uses specialized knowledge for accurate assignment of ICD/CPT codes according to national guidelines. May seek guidance for correct interpretation of coding guidelines and LCDs (Local Coverage Determinations).

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge and specialized formal training equivalent to the two year certification course in medical record keeping principles and practices, anatomy, physiology, pathology, medical terminology, standard nomenclature, and classification of diagnoses and operations, or an Associate’s degree in a related health care field.

Certification may also include a general area of specialty.

Requires three or more years of complex professional coding experience within specialty.

Must demonstrate a level of knowledge and understanding of ICD and CPT coding principles as recommended by the American Health Information Management Association coding competencies, and as normally demonstrated by certification by the American Academy of Professional Coders.

Must be able to work effectively and efficiently in a remote setting, utilizing common office programs, coding software and abstracting systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

About Echoing Green

For 40 years, Echoing Green has been on the front lines of solving the world’s biggest problems, raising up the transformational leaders willing to speak truth to power and challenge the status quo. Through our Fellowship and other programs, we find emerging leaders with the best ideas for social innovation as early as possible and set them on a path to lifelong impact. We provide them with funding, professional development, and a Fellow community that includes founders of organizations like Teach for America, One Acre Fund, Tala, and Last Mile Health.

For more information on Echoing Green, please visit .

Who You’ll Work With

The Development team builds and sustains relationships with individuals, foundations, and institutions that provide resources for Echoing Green’s work. You will work closely with Development colleagues and partner with Finance, Communications, Programs, and organizational leaders to keep information accurate, coordinate fundraising activity, and support consistent relationships with funders.

Reporting to the Vice President of Development, the Development Associate is an important contributor to the team’s day-to-day operations. The role manages donor data, processes gifts, conducts prospect research, prepares information for meetings and outreach, and helps improve the systems and practices that support fundraising.

Previous fundraising experience is not required. We welcome candidates who have built relevant skills through operations, administration, research, data management, finance, customer or client support, project coordination, community-based work, or other settings.

What You'll Do

Donor Data & Systems

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date records in Salesforce, including donor information, interactions, pledges, gifts, and next steps.
  • Review data for accuracy and consistency, correct errors when appropriate, and flag issues that require additional guidance or a system-level fix.
  • Generate donor lists, reports, and other information that Development colleagues and organizational leaders can use to plan and carry out fundraising work.

Gift Processing & Acknowledgment

  • Process incoming gifts accurately and on time, partnering with Finance to confirm coding, allocation, and reconciliation.
  • Prepare and personalize gift acknowledgment letters and tax receipts, using clear and consistent records to support timely donor stewardship.
  • Maintain documentation that makes gift decisions, restrictions, and follow-up steps easy for the appropriate colleagues to understand and use.

Prospect Research & Briefings

  • Conduct respectful, relevant research on individuals, foundations, and companies using appropriate public sources to help identify prospective funders and prepare for engagement.
  • Gather and summarize information for donor and meeting briefings, separating verified information from assumptions and highlighting what is most useful for the audience.
  • Maintain prospect and portfolio information, including relationship history, current status, and agreed next steps.

Development Operations & Coordination

  • Coordinate Development tasks and information across team members and partner teams so that deadlines, responsibilities, and next steps are clear.
  • Contribute to donor engagement and stewardship activities, including events, communications, and follow-up.
  • Support the annual report and other cross-functional projects that require accurate Development data, research, or coordination.
  • Identify practical ways to improve recurring processes, tools, and documentation, and share ideas with the team.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Relevant experience: Experience in operations, administration, research, data management, fundraising, project coordination, or another area where you organized information, followed processes, and supported shared work.
  • Detail orientation: You review your work for accuracy, notice inconsistencies, and correct mistakes. You are comfortable asking questions when information is incomplete or unclear.
  • Focus and follow-through: You organize your work, manage multiple tasks and deadlines, and communicate early when a timeline or priority needs to change.
  • Communication: You share information clearly and respectfully, adjust the level of detail for different audiences, and summarize complex information in a way that is easy to use.
  • Collaboration: You share information, seek input, and coordinate with others so that work does not depend on one person holding all of the context.
  • Equity-mindedness: You are willing to examine assumptions, consider how identity, access, and power can shape experiences and decisions, and apply that awareness to your day-to-day work.
  • Judgment and discretion: You handle confidential and sensitive information with care and understand when to ask for guidance before acting.
  • Tools: You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, and systems used to organize information. Experience with Excel, Salesforce, or another CRM or database is helpful but not required.
  • Mission connection: You are interested in Echoing Green’s mission and in supporting the people and communities at the center of our work.

Benefits

Compensation

Base Salary: $78,000/year

To ensure a fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring process for everyone, the salary for this position is fixed and is non-negotiable.

By removing negotiation from the equation, we close systemic pay gaps and ensure that every member of our team is valued equally from day one. We invest deeply in our culture, our people, and our community, and this predictable, transparent approach is a vital part of how we live our values.

Benefits

We believe benefits should help reduce barriers, honor different life experiences, and reflect our values of care, inclusion, and sustainability. Our benefits are designed to give every team member the time, support, and resources they need to thrive. We offer:

  • Up to 27 days of paid time off each year, plus 9 paid holidays and a 10-day winter break
  • Comprehensive health coverage for medical, dental, and vision needs
  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave and 12 weeks of paid personal sick leave
  • A monthly well-being stipend ($100/month) to use in ways that best support you
  • A monthly wireless stipend ($100/month)
  • A 403(b) retirement savings plan with an employer match of up to 7% of your salary, which begins after you complete your first year at Echoing Green.

Work Location

This role is open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S., provided they are available to work full-time on Eastern Time (New York business hours) to ensure alignment with colleagues and partners. We welcome applicants who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship. This role requires occasional domestic travel (up to two times per year) to cultivate and steward partnerships.

Our Commitment to Equity

At Echoing Green, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented communities—including Black, Indigenous, and people of color; LGBTQ individuals; gender non-conforming and non-binary people; women; veterans; multilingual individuals; and others—to apply, even if they do not meet every listed qualification. Diverse perspectives make our work stronger, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the richness of the global community we serve.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Testing Analyst to support a large-scale digital transformation initiative. This role will focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT), quality assurance, defect management, business readiness, training development, deployment support, and post-implementation stabilization.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), business stakeholders, and project teams to validate system functionality, ensure requirements are met, and support successful user adoption.

The role will also leverage approved AI and Generative AI tools to improve testing efficiency, documentation, training development, knowledge transfer, and quality assurance while ensuring appropriate human review, privacy, security, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and execute test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases based on business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), functional testing, regression testing, enhancement testing, end-to-end testing, and retesting.

  • Identify, document, track, prioritize, and validate defects through resolution.

  • Maintain testing documentation, execution records, traceability, test results, and status reporting.

  • Support integration testing, data migration validation, and business process validation.

  • Participate in sprint and release testing, including test planning, defect triage, smoke testing, deployment validation, and post-deployment verification.

  • Monitor testing progress and communicate risks, issues, dependencies, blockers, and testing outcomes to project stakeholders.

  • Work with Product Owners, SMEs, and business stakeholders to validate business and technical requirements.

  • Develop and maintain user guides, quick reference guides, job aids, training presentations, process documentation, knowledge articles, and FAQs.

  • Prepare training scenarios, demonstrations, training datasets, and other user adoption materials.

  • Support or facilitate training sessions, user walkthroughs, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer activities.

  • Support business readiness, go-live, transition-to-operations, and post-implementation stabilization activities.

  • Identify opportunities to use AI and Generative AI tools to improve test case development, test coverage, defect analysis, reporting, documentation, training, and knowledge management.

  • Review and validate AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, completeness, relevance, accessibility, and alignment with approved requirements.

  • Ensure testing and AI-assisted activities comply with applicable privacy, security, accessibility, quality assurance, and governance standards.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience as a Testing Analyst, QA Analyst, UAT Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar role.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and executing test cases, test scripts, test scenarios, and UAT activities.

  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, enhancement, and release testing.

  • Strong experience with defect identification, documentation, tracking, triage, and resolution validation.

  • Experience working with user stories, business requirements, and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar work management/testing platforms is an asset.

  • Experience developing training materials, user documentation, job aids, FAQs, and knowledge articles.

  • Experience supporting business readiness, deployment, go-live, and post-implementation activities.

  • Familiarity with AI and Generative AI tools and their application to testing, documentation, analysis, and training development.

  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including the importance of human validation of AI-generated outputs.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, Product Owners, SMEs, and business stakeholders.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple testing and readiness activities simultaneously.

Key Skills

UAT | Quality Assurance | Test Case Development | Functional Testing | Regression Testing | Integration Testing | End-to-End Testing | Defect Management | ServiceNow | Agile/Scrum | Business Readiness | Training Development | User Documentation | Deployment Validation | Generative AI | AI-Assisted Testing | Knowledge Transfer | Stakeholder Management

Job Description

Nexus delivers turn-key workforce housing solutions — dining, vending, micro markets, facilities management, transportation, and security — to clients operating in remote or high-demand labor environments. We're looking for someone who thrives on building pipeline from scratch and opening doors with net-new prospects in an assigned geographic territory.

This is a top-of-funnel, lead-generation role that supports the Director of Business Development (DBD). You'll own prospecting, outreach, and qualification — surfacing and warming up opportunities — then hand them off to the DBD, who leads proposal strategy, negotiation, and close. This is not an account management role, and it's not a full-cycle closing role; it's the engine that keeps the DBD's pipeline full of qualified, well-prepared opportunities.

This is a remote position; however, to maximize impact and effectiveness within the assigned territory, candidates should be based in Texas.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prospect and build pipeline independently within your assigned territory — cold outreach, networking, referrals, industry events, and market research to identify net-new opportunities.
    • Qualify opportunities against target criteria (need, budget, timeline, decision-making process) before handing them off, so the DBD's time is spent on warm, vetted conversations.
    • Hit/exceed quarterly and annual lead-generation and pipeline-sourced quota — measured on qualified meetings booked and pipeline value generated, not closed revenue.
    • Manage the warm hand-off to the DBD — briefing them on prospect context, needs, and stakeholders so they can step in seamlessly for proposal and close.
    • Support the DBD through the sales cycle — helping prep proposals, gather competitive intelligence, and coordinate with internal resources (operations, pricing, legal, corporate) — without owning final pricing or contract decisions.
    • Develop and execute a territory prospecting strategy, identifying target verticals and accounts and prioritizing where to invest outreach time for maximum pipeline yield.
    • Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline in CRM — accurate stage tracking, activity logging, and hand-off documentation.
    • Report market and competitive intelligence back to leadership and corporate to inform broader strategy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent quarter-over-quarter pipeline generation, not reliance on inherited or inbound leads
    • High hand-off quality — qualified opportunities the team can move quickly on
    • A healthy, accurately forecasted top-of-funnel pipeline at all times

Job Description:

As a Temporary Talent Acquisition Recruiter at Baker Tilly, you will play an important role in helping the firm attract and select strong talent to support our continued growth. This role provides the opportunity to contribute across a variety of recruiting needs, from conducting a high volume of candidate interviews to managing full-cycle recruiting for select non-client-facing positions.

Success in this role requires strong interviewing and assessment skills, the ability to create a positive candidate experience at scale, and the flexibility to shift priorities based on the firm's evolving hiring needs.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Support high-volume hiring initiatives by conducting a significant volume of structured candidate interviews and assessments across designated roles
  • Evaluate candidate experience, skills and qualifications against established selection criteria and provide clear, timely recommendations to recruiting and hiring partners
  • Deliver a consistent, engaging and high-quality candidate experience throughout the interview and selection process, including in high-volume hiring environments
  • Manage interview activity efficiently while maintaining thorough documentation and timely candidate disposition within the firm's applicant tracking system
  • Partner closely with recruiting team members and hiring stakeholders to understand role requirements, selection criteria, hiring priorities and candidate profiles
  • Participate in interview debriefs and share candidate insights to support timely, informed hiring decisions
  • Maintain effective and timely communication with candidates and internal stakeholders throughout the recruiting process
  • Manage full life-cycle recruiting for select non-client-facing experienced hire positions, which may include:
    • Partnering with hiring leaders and human resources to understand talent needs and develop recruiting strategies
    • Conducting targeted research and sourcing to identify qualified active and passive candidates
    • Screening, interviewing and assessing candidates and presenting qualified talent for consideration
    • Managing candidate and hiring leader communication throughout the interview and selection process
    • Maintaining accurate requisition and candidate information within the firm's applicant tracking system
    • Leading the employment offer process in partnership with human resources and key decision makers, including formulating, negotiating and extending offers
  • Develop and cultivate relationships with candidates, hiring leaders, colleagues and external recruiting sources
  • Understand talent market conditions and use those insights to support effective recruiting and candidate engagement strategies
  • Collaborate across Talent Attraction to support changing hiring priorities and contribute where recruiting needs are greatest
  • Understand, communicate and promote the firm's employee referral program
  • Continually grow and develop recruiting skills and knowledge through internal and external education, training and cross-training opportunities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of
  • 1 year of experience required. Experience in talent acquisition within a professional services firm preferred, will consider an individual with assurance, tax or consulting experience looking to make a career change
  • Experience in full life cycle recruiting focused in professional services or agency recruiting preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate, influence and impact change by leading individuals in a matrix environment
  • Ability to attract and retain talent, proven relationship-building skills, and strong leadership qualities to drive collaboration, influence, and change in a matrix environment
  • Eligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship required

jobs.description:
ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and utilized by the various business units within QAD | Redzone. This engineer joins the core platform team with three main areas of focus: building new capabilities into the platform, helping Applied AI teams at partner business units build and ship Champions correctly, and directly building Champion agents for business-unit use cases when needed.
You will work in the same codebase as the Applied AI engineers you support, which keeps the enablement work
practical and the platform work focused on real problems.

Key Responsibilities
Platform Development

  • Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories
  • Improve developer experience: tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers.
  • Maintain and evolve the MCP tool server and agent infrastructure that BU teams depend on.
  • Identify and address friction points that slow down Champion development or deployment

Applied AI Enablement

  • Support BU Applied AI engineers in building, deploying, and operating Champions correctly
  • Review agent implementations for prompt quality, scope enforcement, auth configuration, and deployment setup
  • Contribute to internal engineering guides and skill documentation
  • Pair with BU engineers on first K8S manifest creation, database registration, and LaunchDarkly prompt rollout

Agent Development

  • Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged
  • Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents
  • Register agents in Champion Server and configure LaunchDarkly-gated prompt rollout across environments

Engineering Practices
We follow trunk-based development with PR-gated merges to main. Engineers are expected to:

  • Write tests before implementing. TDD is the expectation, not a nice-to-have.
  • Keep PRs small and focused; use feature flags to ship partial work incrementally
  • Follow conventional commit format (feat:, fix:, etc.)
  • Be mindful of API and schema backward-compatibility; prefer additive changes over breaking ones
  • Review your own diff before requesting review

Core Requirements

  • Python: Proficient in async Python, Pydantic, type hints, and FastAPI. Experience with the Strands agent SDK or a comparable agentic framework. Testing is non-optional: candidates should be comfortable with pytest, pytest- asyncio, and DeepEval for agent-specific evaluation. We test agent behavior, not just unit logic.
  • Prompt Engineering: Able to write and iterate on production system prompts: XML-structured, scope-enforced, with tool descriptions that guide LLM delegation reliably.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): Solid understanding of MCP and hands-on experience building or consuming MCP servers. Familiarity with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is a strong plus.
  • Agent Patterns: Familiar with multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns beyond basic ReAct: supervisor/subagent delegation, parallel tool use, handoffs, and context management across agent boundaries.
  • Agent Evals: Able to design and run evaluation suites for agent behavior: correctness checks, scope enforcement tests, regression coverage, and systematic prompt iteration based on eval results.
  • Docker: Comfortable authoring Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and local dev environments via docker-compose / make.
  • PostgreSQL: Comfortable with templated INSERT/SELECT, foreign key relationships, and reading an ER diagram.
  • Git / Semantic Versioning: Follows conventional commit format (feat:, fix:) and a PR-based trunk workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Kubernetes: Working knowledge of Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and ServiceAccounts. Able to read and adapt K8s manifests and use kubectl for basic troubleshooting.
  • AWS: Working knowledge of ECR, EKS, IAM, and Bedrock (inference layer).
  • OAuth2 / OIDC: Conceptual understanding of Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, token exchange, and agent auth delegation.
  • Terraform: Beginner-level familiarity; able to make targeted changes to existing modules and interpret a plan diff.
  • LaunchDarkly: Experience managing feature flags or AI config overrides for environment-gated rollout.
  • Document Intelligence / OCR: AWS Textract or comparable pipeline experience for use cases involving structured document extraction.

AI-Native Development

  • We run an AI-native SDLC. AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Cursor) are part of the standard engineering workflow at every stage: planning, implementation, review, and documentation. This is not optional or supplemental; it is how we work. Candidates should be comfortable with AI-assisted development and willing to invest in getting good at it.
  • Use Claude Code and Cursor actively across planning, implementation, and code review
  • Know when AI output is wrong and push back on it.
  • Help drive adoption across the team by sharing what works

What This Role Is Not
This is not an ML research or data science role. The platform team owns cluster networking, observability pipelines, auth configuration, and LLM routing, so deep expertise in those areas is not required. The job is building reliable
software on top of that infrastructure and helping others do the same.

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

Redzone is the #1 Connected Workforce Solution for manufacturers big and small. At Redzone we focus on the customer experience, listening to the customer, and providing solutions that create great outcomes. We are a combination of great leadership, years of manufacturing experience, and an incredible technology team that all work together to create great products.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

About This Job

Dutchie is on a mission to make cannabis accessible — and we do that by building the technology that powers dispensaries end-to-end: point of sale, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, and marketing. Our Support team sits at the center of that mission. When something isn't working for a dispensary, we're the ones who make it right; fast, sharp, and calm.

The Product Support Specialist is our frontline expert across the full Dutchie platform. You'll own inbound contacts for our full stack of products, troubleshoot technically complex issues, navigate multiple systems, and be the person dispensary staff rely on when things get hard in the middle of a busy shift. Many of the analysts, engineers, implementation strategists, operations specialists, and more started in this exact position or very similar, meaning this can be a launchpad for future career growth.

One more thing worth being direct about: Dutchie is actively building AI into how cannabis retail operates. We utilize AI-powered support products, and we're rolling out agentic modules across the platform that change how dispensaries interact with their technology. AI isn't a tool we use on the side, it's woven into the product you'll be supporting and the workflow you'll operate in every day. We're looking for someone genuinely curious about these tools, invested in learning them, and willing to push on them when they fall short. If you've been waiting for a support role where the technology is actually interesting, this is it.

What You’ll Do

Customer interaction and resolution

  • Handle inbound contacts via email, phone, and live chat across POS, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, hardware, and integrations
  • Troubleshoot complex platform issues: back office configuration, register transactions, receipt reconciliation, menu sync failures, discount and pricing issues
  • Support hardware setup and troubleshooting across registers, printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, scales, and computers
  • De-escalate high-urgency situations, dispensary customers are often mid-shift, and the stakes are real
  • Know when to escalate to a higher level or move to a call or Zoom rather than continuing to trade messages

Payments and compliance

  • Triage Pay by Bank issues: bank linking, funding delays, authorization errors, returns, and suspected fraud
  • Support basic METRC and compliance workflows: package tags, manifest generation, transfer workflows
  • Escalate compliance-adjacent issues to Tier 2 with complete documentation

Inventory, products, and integrations

  • Assist with inventory receiving, package creation, inventory room management, and audit workflows
  • Support catalog management, label configuration, and pricing updates
  • Validate integration setup, triage syncing issues, and process API key requests

AI tool usage and platform evolution

  • Work alongside AI-assisted support tooling as a daily part of how you triage, troubleshoot, and route issues — not as a workaround, but as the workflow
  • Support customers using Dutchie’s AI-native products and agentic platform modules that are actively expanding
  • Bring genuine curiosity: experiment with new tools as they roll out, flag gaps when you find them, and contribute to how the tooling improves
  • Contribute to internal documentation when you resolve something that wasn’t written down. Every gap you close makes the whole team faster

Documentation and escalation

  • Write complete ticket documentation on every contact: issue reported, steps taken, outcome, and next steps
  • Apply the 20-minute rule: if meaningful progress toward resolution hasn’t been made, escalate with full context
  • Apply correct classifications, tags, and macros before closing or escalating

What you Bring

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing support role, preferably supporting a SaaS platform
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, you can explain a technical issue in plain language
  • Comfort troubleshooting across multiple product surfaces simultaneously
  • Strong documentation habits: your internal notes are actionable without follow-up
  • Professional composure with frustrated customers in high-urgency situations
  • Comfort working in web-based software, CRMs, and Google Workspace
  • Genuine appetite for AI tooling, you’re curious about how these tools work, willing to push on them, and energized rather than anxious when the technology around you is evolving fast
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays. This is a 7-day operation (5am–9pm PST)

It’s a Bonus if You Have…

  • Experience with POS systems, retail operations technology, or cannabis compliance
  • Familiarity with Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and Zoom
  • Background in the cannabis industry or dispensary operations
  • Experience with the Dutchie platform

Schedule

Full-time, remote. Hours of operation are 5am–9pm PST, 7 days a week. Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays is required - schedules are set through a vacation bid process that gives you structure and predictability while keeping the team covered.

What you’ll get

jobs.title: Amazon Advertising Manager
jobs.excerpt: Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that specializes in operating brands' presence on Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus, and other channels.
jobs.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that specializes in operating brands' presence on Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus, and other channels. The client handles catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising for brands in CPG, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They are seeking a manager to lead their advertising and media program for a portfolio of client brands.

About the Client

The client manages the marketplace business for brands that can't afford to get it wrong. They handle catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising across Amazon (Seller Central and Vendor Central), Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, and other emerging channels, and they run an AI Agentic Commerce practice building their own tooling for this work.

Their clients span consumer packaged goods, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They hire them to operate their channel, not to advise from a distance.

The Role

They are hiring a manager to run the advertising and media program for a portfolio of client brands, and to lead the analysts who execute it.

The position exists because strategy has outgrown a single seat. Their analysts are strong at execution — campaign builds, bid management, optimization, reporting — but they need someone above them who owns the plan: what the strategy is, what it costs, what it should return, and how it gets sold to the client. You'll be the person client leadership talks to about media, and the person their analysts come to when they don't know what to do next.

The work runs on two clocks. Quarterly and annually you're planning: building the media plan and budget for each brand, forecasting the sales that spend produces, and getting client sign-off. Weekly you're operating: reviewing performance with your analysts, deciding what to shift, catching problems before the client does, and pushing the tests that inform the next plan.

The hard part isn't campaign mechanics — it's judgment under incomplete information. You'll commit to a forecast while a client's inventory position is uncertain, defend upper-funnel budget that won't read cleanly for two months, and distinguish a strategy that isn't working from one that hasn't had time. You'll also be asked to find growth in accounts where the obvious moves are already made, which means identifying demand the brand isn't capturing rather than optimizing what's already there.

You'll have real latitude over strategy, budget, and how your team works, and they'll expect you to own outcomes rather than effort. You'll partner with their Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness and their Design Team on creative, since performance in these channels is capped by the quality of what the ads point to.

Amazon is their center of gravity, and Amazon DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud are central to how they differentiate. This is not a Sponsored Products–only role.

What You'll Own

  • Media planning: Annual, quarterly, and event-level plans across Amazon Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP, Walmart Connect, and Target Roundel — channel and tactic mix, funnel allocation, and spend timed to the calendar that matters. Plans should account for inventory, retail readiness, competition, and seasonality, reserve budget for testing, and state assumptions clearly enough to defend six weeks later.
  • Forecasting and budget management: Budget forecasting, pacing, and sales forecasts that connect spend to topline results. Scenario ranges with stated assumptions, not single-number promises. Efficiency targets managed without losing sight of incrementality.
  • Analysis: You'll do the analytical work yourself rather than wait on a dashboard — interrogating search term, placement, product-level, DSP, and business reports, and using AMC for path to purchase, audience overlap, frequency, cross-channel assist, and new-to-brand contribution. They want people who know what question they're asking before they query, can tell signal from a short-term wobble, connect ad data to retail data, and check their own math.
  • Growth and new audiences: Find the demand a brand isn't reaching: unclaimed search terms, untargeted subcategories, competitor share worth contesting, unused placements, adjacent use cases. Build and test audiences in AMC and DSP beyond the obvious — lapsed and repeat purchasers, cross-category buyers, in-market adjacents, lookalikes from high-value cohorts, prospecting pools sized for real new-to-brand reach. Run it as a program: hypothesis, test, clean read, scale or kill.
  • Team leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the analysts running daily campaign work. Set the standard for QA, bulk-operation hygiene, naming conventions, and documentation. Review closely enough to catch the change that shouldn't have shipped, and explain the reasoning rather than just correcting it.
  • Client communication: Bring plans, strategy, and performance to client senior management with a recommendation rather than a set of options. Anticipate the objection, name the tradeoff, show what you'd trade to get what you're asking for. Adjust for the audience — a CFO wants payback and risk, a brand lead wants positioning and reach, a founder wants to know whether it works. When results disappoint, say so first and bring a plan.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years creating, managing, and optimizing Amazon Sponsored Ads campaigns (Sponsored Products, Brands, Brands Video, Display) and Amazon DSP campaigns
  • Experience leading digital advertising teams — hiring, coaching, reviewing, holding a standard
  • Hands-on experience pulling insights from Amazon Marketing Cloud and acting on them
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable building your own models and reasoning about incrementality, attribution, and significance
  • Media planning, budget forecasting, and sales forecasting experience
  • Depth in PPC management and optimization, and in programmatic display
  • A track record of new-to-brand acquisition and consistent incremental sales growth, with numbers you can walk us through
  • Clear writing and speaking, including presenting media plans to client senior leadership and getting agreement
  • Honesty by default: you report the number you wish were different, and you persuade by being prepared rather than polished

Preferred

  • Google Data Studio / Looker Studio and SQL, particularly for AMC queries
  • Agentic AI workflows — using AI to speed up analysis and build tooling
  • Walmart Connect and/or Target Roundel campaign management
  • Retail fundamentals: Buy Box, inventory health, catalog integrity, promotions, subscriptions, and how each limits what advertising can do
  • Agency or multi-brand portfolio experience
  • Advanced Excel and bulk operations; Python or scripting a plus

Who Does Well Here

The work is cyclical and the peaks are demanding — Q4 and Prime Day compress a quarter of decisions into a few weeks. The people who do well here treat a bad month as information rather than a setback, and tend to show up already three hypotheses deep.

They also look for ownership (you escalate early and don't lose things), intellectual honesty (you'd rather be corrected than confidently wrong), client empathy (your recommendation lands inside someone else's budget and headcount), attention to detail, and a habit of fixing a manual process the third time you run it.

What Success Looks Like

  • 90 days: You know your portfolio cold — structure, history, constraints. Your analysts know what you expect. You've given them a clear read on what's working and what isn't.
  • 6 months: You've materially improved the ad architecture on your priority accounts, you own the client strategy conversation, and you have tests in market on untapped demand.
  • 12 months: Your portfolio shows new-to-brand and incremental growth that holds up under scrutiny, your analysts have grown, and clients ask for you by name.

How to Stand Out

Be ready to talk about one account you turned around and one you didn't, and what each taught you. They care more about how you think than where you've worked.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's Design & Research org is a team of ~100 designers, researchers, and content experts dedicated to making grocery shopping effortless for everyone across our four-sided marketplace. The Fulfillment team sits at the heart of the Instacart experience, owning the key moments that determine whether an order goes right — from the moment a customer places an order to delivery at their door. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own key Order Quality design work, partnering closely with 3+ product managers and their engineering teams across some of the most complex and high-visibility problem spaces at Instacart. This role is a rare opportunity to make a deep, measurable impact on an experience that touches every Instacart customer and, in many cases, our Shopper experience as well.

About the Job

  • Own key Order Quality design initiatives end-to-end — from zero-to-one concept exploration through execution-level delivery — across multiple concurrent projects spanning consumer and shopper experiences.
  • Become the go-to domain expert for Order Quality, building deep knowledge across active workstreams and proactively maintaining continuity on previously approved work while absorbing net-new asks from the product team.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to 3+ product managers — collaborating on product strategy, using design to help envision solutions at scale, and partnering closely with engineering teams to ensure execution-level handoff is thorough, accurate, and actionable.
  • Navigate seamlessly between high-level strategic conversations with design and product leadership and detailed, craft-focused execution work — including Figma flows, polish passes, and design systems collaboration.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across product, engineering, research, data science, and brand; represent Order Quality design in crits, reviews, and stakeholder presentations — including to heads of Product and Design.
  • Apply modern AI tools in daily workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping, and iteration, bringing a forward-looking point of view on how AI can improve both the design process and the customer experience.

About You

  • 6+ years designing consumer-facing digital products across web and mobile, with a portfolio demonstrating complex, multi-step product journeys and measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to own work end-to-end — from early problem framing and zero-to-one concept development through high-quality execution and delivery — without delegating either end of the spectrum.
  • Experience working across multiple complex problem spaces simultaneously, collaborating with several product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting work confidently to cross-functional partners and senior/executive stakeholders.
  • Fluency in Figma, with the ability to produce high-fidelity flows, interaction design, and design system-aligned UI at speed.
  • Genuine curiosity and enthusiasm for design craft, with an eye toward how AI tools and emerging capabilities can improve both workflow and product outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in e-commerce, grocery, marketplace, or logistics products where fulfillment, order integrity, or transactional trust are core to the experience.
  • Background designing for multi-sided marketplace platforms — balancing the needs of consumers, shoppers, and other stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience in larger corporate or agency environments, with exposure to structured design processes and multi-team collaboration at scale.
  • Comfort working within and improving established design language systems, ensuring consistency and quality across complex product surfaces.
