  • Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
  • Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts
  • Support broader GRC team program initiatives, including policy writing, security awareness training, and third-party security risk assessments

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • Subject matter expert in information security frameworks, practices, policies, standards, and procedures (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/2, or equivalent)
  • 6+ years of experience in Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Technology Compliance roles with a strong understanding of audit processes
  • Exposure to global regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, FFIEC, EBA, NYDFS) and experience integrating them into compliance programs

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Peer Support Specialist to join our Support Transition and Reentry (STAR) team! The Peer Support Specialist provides support to recipients enrolled in the Trillium STAR program. The STAR program is a specialty care team serving adults experiencing BH or IDD conditions who are exiting incarceration. Recipients are referred by the Correctional Facility up to 90 days before release. STAR provides care coordination pre-release and post-release until the individual moves to ongoing Care Management services and supports. The Peer Support Specialist educates members and guardians throughout the transition process about how to effectively navigate the criminal justice system, behavioral, physical and social services systems and about the existence of community-based services and supports. The Peer Support Specialist is responsible for working with the recipient’s care team to provide transition linkages including school, employment, housing coordination, community service opportunities, provider services and other identified treatment supports and services. This individual will work with community resources and services to meet the identified needs for recipients who are transitioning back to the community and address specific barriers to reentry which may include access to insurance, disability benefits, transportation, food, clothing, and a safe place to live.

Our Company

The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and Provincial authorities in Canada. NERC's jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

jobs.title: FedRamp Compliance Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAbnormal AI is looking for a Federal Security and Compliance Analyst who wants to help build how modern federal compliance operates inside a fast-moving cybersecurity company.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Federal Security and Compliance Analyst who wants to help build how modern federal compliance operates inside a fast-moving cybersecurity company.

You will work at the intersection of security engineering, cloud operations, security, and federal compliance, helping Abnormal Gov scale its FedRAMP High/Class D security and compliance program. You will own security requirement implementation and evidence, work directly with technical teams to drive risk and remediation to closure, and help build our compliance as code capabilities in alignment with FedRAMP 20x.

You'll have meaningful ownership early, with the opportunity to improve processes rather than simply inherit them. The strongest candidate will be technically curious, highly organized, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and motivated by making compliance more accurate, automated, measurable, and operationally useful.

What you will do

  • Own assigned federal security and compliance workstreams from requirement interpretation through implementation, evidence collection, remediation, and review readiness.
  • Drive recurring continuous monitoring and evidence workflows, coordinating across Security, FedOps, Engineering, IT, People Operations, GRC, and other control performers to ensure evidence is current, complete, traceable, and retained correctly.
  • Support vulnerability detection and response, including reconciling findings from tools such as Wiz, Nessus, and Burp; risk-based triage; Jira routing; SLA tracking; remediation follow-through; validation; and audit-ready evidence.
  • Partner with technical teams on security and compliance impact, supporting Security Impact Assessments, Significant Change Requests, control implementation decisions, and other change-management activities before changes reach production.
  • Help build Abnormal's compliance-as-code program, including structured control content, JSON/YAML or other machine-readable artifacts, schema validation, evidence indexing, automation, deterministic document generation, and reusable workflows.
  • Maintain accurate control, evidence, remediation, risk, and ownership records, proactively identifying gaps, aging items, dependencies, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Contribute to federal authorization and assessment artifacts, including control documentation, Security Decision Records, certification-package content, assessor requests, and continuous monitoring deliverables.
  • Support federal customer assurance by providing clear, accurate compliance guidance and artifacts for customer onboarding, POVs, DDQs, RFPs, and other government or regulated customer requests.

Must Haves

  • 2+ years of experience in security, compliance, GRC, risk, audit, security operations, or a related discipline, preferably in a cloud, SaaS, government, or highly regulated environment.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 and an understanding of how security controls translate into technical implementation, operational processes, and audit evidence.
  • Experience with one or more core compliance operations such as evidence collection, control documentation, vulnerability remediation, risk tracking, audit support, or continuous monitoring.
  • Technical curiosity and the ability to read architecture diagrams, security documentation, vulnerability findings, Jira tickets, logs, or engineering materials and turn them into clear compliance actions.
  • Ability to work effectively with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure/Operations, IT, and other technical teams without needing every problem or requirement to be fully defined in advance.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce documentation that is precise enough for assessors and technical teams while remaining understandable to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong operational discipline: you can manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, owners, and deadlines while identifying problems and escalating risk early.
  • A demonstrated tendency to improve the way work gets done through automation, better processes, clearer documentation, reusable templates, better data, or simpler workflows.

.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with FedRAMP High, FedRAMP Moderate, FISMA, CMMC, GovRAMP, or other U.S. government security frameworks.
  • Exposure to compliance-as-code, OSCAL, JSON/YAML schemas, Git-based workflows, automated validation, Markdown/PDF generation, or machine-readable authorization artifacts.
  • Familiarity with tools or environments such as AWS GovCloud, Wiz, Splunk, Okta, Jira, GitLab, Nessus, Burp, or cloud-native vulnerability-management platforms.
  • Experience supporting Security Impact Assessments, Significant Change Requests, POA&M/ConMon workflows, 3PAO assessments, or federal authorization packages.
  • Basic scripting or automation experience—such as Python, APIs, CI/CD workflows, or data transformation—or a strong interest in developing those skills.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$114,800—$173,250 USD

These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. jobs.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Senior Recruiter is responsible for managing the recruitment efforts for assigned areas of The Home Depot Enterprise. Their role is to provide the support, knowledge and tools needed for successful job placement. In partnership with HR Leaders and Talent Acquisition leadership, this role will develop talent acquisition strategies to attract and hire the best in class for functional areas of the business. The Senior Recruiter will manage the full lifecycle for all hires. Key responsibilities include working with Store Support Center functional groups to create recruitment strategies to fit their needs, and monitoring selection processes when appropriate to ensure The Home Depot is making the best hiring decisions. It is also the responsibility of the Senior Recruiter to facilitate new recruitment initiatives and complete special projects as assigned. Communicating with others, at all levels, building relationships and planning projects are critical skills for successful performance in this position.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Use strategic planning information to implement an innovative, function-specific talent acquisition plan to develop a strong external bench of talent that supports The Home Depot's talent acquisition strategy. Acquire industry knowledge and competitive market data and use this information to drive potential changes to the staffing plan..
  • Perform full lifecycle recruiting to include sourcing strategy development with a clear focus on diversity. The successful Senior Recruiter will also assist with the determination of screening criteria and execution of screening, interviewing, and the negotiation of salaries.
  • Maintain communication with all related business partners in order to perform all related Talent Acquisition functions. Work through any communication gaps to ensure staffing effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Execute recruitment plans in order to achieve staffing metrics including candidate quality, candidate throughput, and efficient time to offer. Provide status reports on these metrics to include review of open requisition status and candidate throughput.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the all related stakeholders in order to meet talent acquisition goals. Work with appropriate groups to identify and resolve issues.
  • Develop individualized sourcing strategies for the functional areas and execute appropriately. Strategies should include cold calling, building networks and maintaining interests with passive candidates.
  • Ensure consistency, efficiency and compliance with federal, state and local laws, and company policies. Ensure all TA activities are compliant with the established sourcing, recruiting, and selection procedures including maintaining appropriate recordkeeping

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:
  • Typically reports to Manager, Talent Acquisition
  • No direct responsibility for supervising others but will assist in coordination of activities of Recruiters and Staffing Coordinators

Travel Requirements:
  • Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time.

Physical Requirements:
  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:
  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:
  • 5 plus years of corporate Talent Acquisition experience
  • Recruiting expertise and expert knowledge of internet search tools and strong sourcing strategies
  • Experience creating and executing a wide range of recruiting initiatives
  • The knowledge, skills, and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.
  • Bilingual Spanish is a plus.
  • Corporate recruitment experience for a retailer preferred. (ex: IT, HR, Legal, Merchandising, etc.)

Minimum Education:

Preferred Education:

  • 5

Preferred Years of Work Experience:

Minimum Leadership Experience:
  • None

Preferred Leadership Experience:
  • None

Certifications:
  • None

  • Strong customer service orientation in order to build and maintain a strong candidate pool including negotiation skills.
  • Creative and innovative in recruitment activities including the understanding of successful candidate traits, demographic characteristics, and talent management inputs
  • Knowledge of employment laws and regulations, equal opportunity laws and other applicable federal and state regulations including, but not limited to EEO and OFCCP.

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

BillionToOne is looking to hire an Associate General Counsel, its fifth attorney, for its growing Legal & Compliance team to advise on a variety of issues. This role will have a significant impact on developing and implementing legal and compliance policies, practices, and systems. You will partner and collaborate with members of our Finance, Sales, Market Access, Reimbursement, R&D, Marketing, Supply Chain, and HR teams. This role reports to our General Counsel, Chief Compliance Officer & Secretary and can be located onsite, hybrid, or fully remote (with occasional travel).

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify and address legal and compliance risks across Product, Marketing, Commercial Operations, Market Access/Reimbursement, Research & Development, People Ops and Finance — anticipating issues rather than waiting to be asked
  • Independently identify gaps in existing policies and processes and drive build-out of compliance infrastructure
  • Develop processes and infrastructure to ensure compliance with applicable external requirements, soliciting feedback from internal stakeholders, preparing and drafting policies/SOPs and overseeing implementation and training in a variety of areas
  • Advise on company contracts, including drafting, negotiating, reviewing, interpreting, and managing strategic, high-value contracts
  • Take ownership of legal questions in unfamiliar subject areas — research, collect business input, and drive to resolution with appropriate escalation
  • Partner with legal team members to develop and build legal and compliance infrastructure and program for lab services/life science organization

  • Ability to be highly resourceful, adaptable, creative and nimble in a high-growth, fast-paced environment
  • Track record of taking on unfamiliar legal problems with minimal oversight and driving them to a positive result for the business
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity in a lean legal team, making judgment calls without a playbook
  • JD and licensed to practice law in one or more US jurisdictions
  • 5+ years of experience in a law firm and/or in-house legal department, ideally with exposure to life science or health care organizations
  • Experience advising commercial leaders and colleagues on business strategies, product promotion, sales programs and transactions and other commercial initiatives.
  • Experience developing processes to comply with legal/regulatory requirements, drafting and implementing policies and procedures, and delivering employee training
  • Exposure to some combination of the following subject areas: commercial compliance, securities/corporate governance, contract drafting and negotiation, intellectual property, and labor and employment matters
  • Strong team-player with willingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in wherever needed
  • Strong leadership skills, with ability to clearly communicate effective legal solutions to leadership and colleagues in a collaborative yet consultative way that meet business objectives yet appropriately mitigate risks

Nice-to-Haves:

Familiarity with some or all of the following:

  • Start-up, emerging high-growth company experience
  • Molecular diagnostics/genetic company or CLIA lab

Benefits And Perks:

  • Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients
  • Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings
  • The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousand patients

  • Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)
  • Supplemental fertility benefits coverage

  • A variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

jobs.excerpt: About UsDenvr Dataworks Corp.  (“Denvr”) is a vertically integrated AI Platform Services company with headquarters in Calgary, Canada.
jobs.description:
About Us

Denvr Dataworks Corp. (“Denvr”) is a vertically integrated AI Platform Services company with headquarters in Calgary, Canada. We provide foundational compute infrastructure and services to support the broader AI ecosystem and its end users. The platform includes cloud-native solutions for training, inference, high-performance computing, data processing, scalable storage, and a suite of software toolsets that accelerate the development, deployment, and integration of AI applications.

These capabilities are accessible via the public Denvr AI Cloud or through Private AI Platform Services, which offer fully dedicated, sovereign environments with enhanced security. Private deployments incorporate advanced data centers, optimized compute architectures, high-throughput storage fabrics, and tightly integrated platform operations software—engineered to meet the demands of large-scale, mission-critical AI workloads.

We design proprietary AI Data Centers powered by our ultra-efficient, modular data centers built for hyper-scale AI deployments.

At Denvr, we’re driven to create exceptional customer experiences that empower AI innovators, entrepreneurs, and enterprises to achieve real results. Our mission is to help unlock breakthroughs that transform industries, enhance creativity, and shape a better future.

Why Join Us

Joining Denvr means being part of a world-class team in the fast-moving field of AI and high-performance computing.

We value curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Our people are proactive problem solvers who take pride in delivering great results, thrive in open and transparent environments, and enjoy learning by doing.

If you’re forward-thinking, motivated by innovation, and excited to help drive a rapidly growing business, Denvr is the place to make an impact—and grow your career alongside exceptional teammates.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional purchasing role. For the right person, this is an opportunity to build and own a strategic procurement function at the center of a rapidly growing cloud infrastructure business.

As an experienced Senior Procurement Leader, you will own and drive our strategic sourcing and supplier relationships across cloud and data center infrastructure.

We are looking for a highly commercial, technically credible procurement executive who can operate at senior levels with the world's leading technology OEMs and infrastructure suppliers. You will negotiate major commercial agreements, build strategic vendor relationships, secure capacity and supply, and ensure Denvr achieves highly competitive economics as we continue to scale our infrastructure platform.

The role will span compute (GPUs and accelerated servers), high-performance networking, storage, and specialized data center infrastructure, including colocation, power delivery, HVAC/cooling systems, and modular facility construction, with end-to-end ownership of commercial strategy and key vendor partnerships.

You should be equally comfortable negotiating a complex multi-million-dollar hardware agreement, discussing product roadmaps with an OEM executive, challenging commercial and contractual terms, and working internally with engineering, finance and executive leadership on infrastructure strategy.

The Mission

Denvr isn’t building traditional data centers; we are manufacturing the future of AI infrastructure - building next-generation cloud infrastructure for demanding compute workloads.

As we scale, strategic procurement becomes a significant competitive advantage. The economics we achieve with OEMs, the capacity we can secure, the relationships we develop and the speed at which we can deploy infrastructure all directly influence our ability to compete.

This role will have significant visibility and influence across the company and will work closely with executive leadership, engineering, finance and operations.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Procurement & Commercial Negotiation

  • Lead strategic sourcing and procurement for major infrastructure categories, including:
  • GPU and accelerated compute platforms
  • Enterprise and hyperscale server infrastructure
  • High-speed networking, switching, and interconnect
  • High-performance storage platforms and specialized infrastructure software / parallel file systems
  • Data center colocation leases, high-density power commitments, and IP transit / dark fiber
  • Maintenance, warranties, and lifecycle support services
  • Other strategic hardware and infrastructure required to operate and expand our cloud platform
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies that optimize total cost of ownership, commercial terms, supply availability, performance and long-term strategic value.
  • Lead negotiations for significant capital purchases, framework agreements, volume commitments and strategic supplier arrangements.
  • Create competitive tension across vendors and ensure Denvr understands the true market economics of the equipment and services we procure.

OEM & Strategic Supplier Relationships

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with major OEMs, component manufacturers, colocation providers, and channel partners (e.g., NVIDIA, Supermicro, Dell, Equinix, Arista)
  • Leverage partner relationships to optimize pricing structures, hardware allocations, lead times, financing terms, roadmap visibility, and early access to emerging technologies.

Use those relationships to improve:

  • Pricing and discount structures
  • Allocation and product availability
  • Lead times
  • Payment and financing terms
  • Warranty and support arrangements
  • Product roadmap visibility
  • Early access to new technologies
  • Capacity commitments
  • Escalation paths
  • Strategic partnership opportunities

Infrastructure Economics

  • Work closely with Finance, Engineering and Operations to understand the economics of our infrastructure at a detailed level.
  • Evaluate purchasing decisions based not simply on unit price, but on lifecycle cost, density, power consumption, utilization, support costs, deployment timelines and revenue-generating capability.
  • Develop robust commercial models for major infrastructure investments and provide leadership with clear recommendations and alternatives.
  • Identify opportunities to materially improve infrastructure cost per unit of compute and overall return on invested capital.

Supply Chain & Capacity Planning

  • Translate infrastructure growth forecasts into forward-looking procurement and capacity pipelines.
  • Anticipate supply constraints and develop multi-sourcing strategies to mitigate hardware allocation risks.
  • Maintain deep visibility into OEM manufacturing cycles, component lead times, product roadmaps, and end-of-life schedules.

Contracts & Commercial Governance

  • Lead commercial contract structuring in close alignment with Legal and Finance, focusing on SLAs, liability, price protection, and supply guarantees.
  • Establish standard procurement workflows, approval thresholds, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Ensure supplier alignment with Denvr’s Supplier Code of Conduct, security standards, and background verification requirements.

Who You Are

The Person

  • Commercial & Analytical: Deeply understands technology go-to-market models, OEM margin structures, and where commercial leverage exists.
  • Technically Conversant: Comfortable bridging technical engineering specifications with C-suite commercial negotiations.
  • Constructive Challenger: Confident testing assumptions and pushing both internal teams and external partners for optimal outcomes.
  • High-Growth Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced environment where hardware architectures, lead times, and capacity demands change quickly.

Qualifications

As an experienced procurement, sourcing or commercial leader with a strong track record in cloud infrastructure, hyperscale computing, data centers, telecommunications or enterprise technology hardware, ideally, you bring:

  • 10+ years of strategic sourcing, procurement, or commercial leadership experience focused on data center hardware, hyperscale cloud, or enterprise IT infrastructure.
  • Proven track record negotiating complex, multi-million-dollar hardware, colocation, and software contracts.
  • Established executive network across the data center, server OEM, networking, and component supplier ecosystems.
  • Deep knowledge of GPU/accelerated computing architectures, high-performance networking, and data center economics.
  • Strong financial modeling capabilities, including TCO analysis and capital investment evaluation.
  • Excellent contract negotiation and executive presentation skills.
  • Executive presence to represent Denvr alongside senior leadership at major global technology companies.

If you are passionate about technology, system design and innovative technical solutions, and want to be part of a remote-first forward-thinking company, Denvr would love to hear from you.

Click on the link to apply!

jobs.excerpt: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there—as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Senior Manager, Social and Creator Marketing at BetterHelp, you’ll join our Brand Team alongside a diverse group of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy.

You’ll help shape how BetterHelp shows up in culture and how our brand reaches people organically—building the strategy, channels, partnerships, and systems that turn great brand ideas into sustained attention, conversation, and relevance.

As a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day—with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for an experienced brand marketer and content distribution strategist to lead BetterHelp’s organic brand presence and help more of our ideas travel.

You’ll own the strategy for how BetterHelp builds attention, relevance, and community across owned and earned channels—from social and creators to partnerships, community, long-form content, PR amplification, and emerging platforms. You’ll think beyond individual posts or influencer campaigns to build an interconnected organic ecosystem: identifying where our audiences spend time, what they care about, what BetterHelp has permission to say, and how the right ideas can reach the right people.

This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, culture, content, and distribution. You’ll pair strong creative instincts with a rigorous understanding of channels and audiences, helping BetterHelp create work that people actively choose to engage with, share, and participate in.

What will you do?

  • Own BetterHelp’s organic brand and distribution strategy, defining how the brand earns attention and builds relevance across social, creators, partnerships, community, long-form content, PR amplification, and emerging channels.
  • Build an audience-first distribution model that identifies where our audiences spend time, how they consume and share content, and which channels and formats are best suited to different brand ideas.
  • Turn brand strategy into channel strategy, translating BetterHelp’s positioning, campaigns, and cultural point of view into distinctive platform-native programs and always-on content.
  • Develop the organic amplification strategy for major brand moments, working closely with Brand, Creative, PR, Partnerships, and Growth teams to extend campaigns beyond their initial launch and maximize their cultural reach and lifespan.
  • Lead our owned social strategy across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn, establishing clear roles for each channel and continuously evolving our approach based on audience behavior and platform shifts.
  • Lead creator and influencer strategy as a core organic distribution channel, developing thoughtful programs and long-term relationships that give creators meaningful ways to participate in and extend the BetterHelp brand.
  • Build relationships with creators, cultural voices, communities, and partners who authentically align with our mission and can help BetterHelp participate in relevant conversations.
  • Identify new and emerging distribution opportunities, testing new platforms, formats, communities, partnerships, and content models that can expand BetterHelp’s organic reach.
  • Develop a strategy for long-form and search-driven brand content, including YouTube, podcasts, SEO/AEO, and other formats that can compound audience and brand value over time.
  • Create an international organic distribution strategy, identifying which approaches can scale globally and where local platforms, creators, cultural context, and audience behaviors require a differentiated approach.
  • Lead planning for organic brand activations and cultural moments, including creator programs, events, partnerships, and community-led initiatives designed to generate participation and earned conversation.
  • Act as the connective tissue across organic, earned, and paid distribution, ensuring strong ideas move effectively across channels while maintaining a consistent brand strategy and point of view.
  • Partner closely with Growth and Paid Social teams to identify organic content, creators, formats, and audience insights that can inform paid amplification—while using performance learnings to sharpen organic strategy.
  • Develop measurement frameworks for organic brand impact, looking beyond surface-level engagement to understand audience growth, conversation, share of attention, content velocity, brand impact, and the downstream value of organic distribution.
  • Manage and mentor a growing team across organic social, creators, and related distribution functions, establishing clear priorities, operating rhythms, and opportunities for development.
  • Manage budgets and external partners across creators, agencies, partnerships, content production, and brand activations, ensuring investments ladder back to a clear distribution strategy.
  • Build scalable operating systems, including briefs, playbooks, channel frameworks, compliance guardrails, measurement systems, and AI-assisted workflows that allow the team to increase its impact without proportional headcount growth.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance to develop practical frameworks for social, creator, and organic content across US and international markets.
  • Stay deeply connected to culture and the evolving media landscape, bringing emerging behaviors, platforms, creators, communities, and distribution models back into BetterHelp’s brand strategy.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $200,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

jobs.description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent!

We are dedicated to connecting talented individuals with remarkable companies in need of their skills. Our goal is to create fulfilling job opportunities for professionals around the world.

Our client:

A DTC brand running at roughly $70M annual run rate in the home & comfort niche, with a primary focus on the US market.
They’re looking for a true operator to take ownership of our entire operation and become the right hand to the founders.

The Role

We need an operator who takes full ownership across all teams, makes sure things actually get done, holds people accountable, and rolls up their sleeves to do it themselves when needed.

You’ll report directly to the CEO and co-founder, take operations off their plate piece by piece, and grow into full company-wide operational ownership. The goal is simple: the founders focus on vision, brand, and growth, while you make sure the entire machine runs smoothly end to end.

What You’ll Own

  • Supply Chain & Sourcing — Supplier relationships and negotiations, COGS optimization, lead times, inventory planning, demand forecasting, reducing single-supplier dependency.
  • Product Operations — Driving new product development speed and quality, ensuring compliance (labels, washing tags, legal requirements), feeding return and customer data into product improvement.
  • Fulfillment & Logistics — Delivery performance, 3PL and warehouse management across regions, shipping cost control, Q4 peak planning.
  • Customer Experience — Support operations, CSAT, returns, refunds, chargeback and dispute handling.
  • Finance & Data — P&L oversight, SKU-level profitability, cash flow visibility, working with accountants, building operational reporting.
  • Systems & Automation — Tool consolidation, workflow automation, SOPs, AI-driven process optimization.
  • People & HR Ops — Hiring, onboarding, team structure, contractor management, accountability across departments.
  • Front-End Coordination — Ensuring the operational side of marketing (website backend, tracking, integrations, CRO infrastructure) runs smoothly and coordinates cleanly with the founders’ paid acquisition and brand work.
  • Legal & Compliance — Overseeing IP and brand protection, contracts, and regulatory compliance across markets (with external counsel)

Requirements

  • Young, hungry, and flexible: a machine and a true operator who wants to build, not just delegate
  • Genuinely cross-functional: you’ve owned supply chain AND fulfillment AND CX AND finance/systems, not just one specialty
  • Experience at a similar-size DTC/e-commerce brand (8-9 figure revenue) is a must
  • Hands-on and execution-driven: you spot problems before they’re raised and fix them, doing it yourself when needed
  • Strong at holding teams and external partners (suppliers, agencies) accountable
  • Systems thinker who builds processes that scale, not just firefights
  • Fluent English, comfortable working across US and EU time zones
  • Direct, no-nonsense, transparent communicator
  • Self-directed: thrives with autonomy, doesn’t need hand-holding

Not a fit: the cocky, 20-years-experience type who only tells people what to do and won’t get into the work themselves. We want someone with real experience who still loves rolling up their sleeves.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with China-based manufacturing and supplier management
  • Multi-market operations (US + EU + AU) and cross-border logistics
  • Finance or consulting background with real operational execution
  • Experience scaling a business through rapid growth

Benefits

  • High-impact role with real ownership and autonomy
  • Direct partnership with the founders
  • Fast-moving, high-growth environment with room to build
  • Performance-based bonus on top of base, tied to clear KPIs
  • Growth path into full COO ownership

Location: Remote. LatAm preferred (strong operator talent, US-timezone friendly), Europe also possible.

Compensation: Flexible depending on location, experience, and overall package.
Base plus performance bonus for the right senior operator. The package is built around the individual.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

Job Title: Principal Biostatistician (Oncology) - FSP

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

As a Principal Biostatistician, you will provide strategic statistical leadership for Oncology clinical trials, with a particular focus on hematological malignancies including multiple myeloma, leukemia, and lymphoma. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality statistical support across the clinical development lifecycle, ensuring compliance with regulatory and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Principal-level Biostatistics leadership for Oncology clinical development programs and studies
    • Lead and contribute to statistical activities across clinical trials, acting as the primary statistical representative on assigned studies
    • Review and provide quality control oversight of SDTM datasets and associated deliverables, ensuring compliance with CDISC standards
    • Collaborate closely with Statistical Programming, Data Management, Clinical Operations, and Regulatory teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of statistical outputs
    • Support the interpretation and communication of study results to cross-functional stakeholders
    • Ensure all statistical deliverables meet quality, regulatory, and timeline expectations
    • Effectively communicate statistical concepts, analyses, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences
    • Contribute to study design discussions, protocol development, and statistical methodology as required

Candidate Requirements

✔ Advanced experience as a Principal Biostatistician within a Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or CRO environment
✔ Strong experience within Oncology clinical development
✔ Demonstrated expertise in hematological malignancies, including multiple myeloma, leukemia, and/or lymphoma
✔ Strong knowledge and practical application of CDISC standards, including SDTM
✔ Experience performing or overseeing QC of SDTM datasets and related outputs
✔ Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders
✔ Excellent verbal and written communication skills
✔ Strong understanding of statistical principles and clinical trial methodology

Preferred Qualifications

✔ Experience serving as Lead Study Statistician within a cross-functional clinical development team
✔ Knowledge and experience in clinical trial statistical design and study planning
✔ Experience supporting regulatory submissions and interactions with health authorities
✔ Familiarity with advanced statistical programming tools and industry-standard processes

Please send an application that speaks directly to how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. .

The Data Transformation team is responsible for building and operating batch and real-time transformation pipelines and platforms for 400+ product teams at Stripe. We're aiming to make data development and management workflow at Stripe a breeze with emphasis on producing high-quality datasets used for critical analytics, dashboards, and workflows at Stripe. The products owned by this team are widely adopted with 800+ weekly active users improving developer productivity for data users manifold. The team is in an interesting phase of innovation tied to the topmost priority for Stripe, building and executing the strategic roadmap for streaming transformation, incremental processing, and ergonomic data modeling.

We empower our users ranging from data scientists to engineers building pipelines to create exceptional Stripe product experiences while providing a robust transformation platform for critical dashboarding, analytics, and workflows at Stripe including user-facing reporting products Sigma and Radar.

We adopt a combination of open-source technologies and in-house-built software to ensure high scalability, reliability, and usability of our transformation offerings. Key example technologies include Spark, Airflow, Iceberg, Hive, S3, SQL, Python, Scala, GRPC, Kafka, and FlinkSQL.

As an Engineering Manager of the Data Transformation team, you'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate with infrastructure and product engineering orgs, and advance the Data Transformation roadmap and adoption at Stripe. You'll drive critical workstreams for the topmost priorities at Stripe around delivering high-quality, materialized datasets for Stripe products and AI agents.

  • Successfully recruited and built great teams

PRIMARY PURPOSE: The Scrum Master is responsible for driving predictable, high‑quality delivery across multiple AI initiatives supporting insurance and claims operations. This role serves as a senior Agile delivery leader, reinforcing disciplined Agile practices, protecting sprint commitments, and enabling sustainable delivery velocity in a high‑demand, regulated operational environment. In addition to Scrum leadership, the role applies project management principles to support planning, execution, governance, stakeholder communication, dependency management, risk mitigation, and delivery reporting across complex AI initiatives.

The Scrum Master supports multiple AI delivery teams or complex initiatives working on solutions that directly impact claims workflows, customer experience, financial outcomes, and regulatory compliance. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy, influencing delivery standards, stakeholder expectations, and cross‑team coordination and project execution to ensure successful delivery of strategic business objectives.

  • Facilitates and governs Agile ceremonies across one or more AI teams, ensuring Sprint Planning reflects realistic capacity, cross‑team dependencies, and clearly defined objectives grounded in operational priorities. Partners closely with Product Managers/Owners to ensure backlog readiness, story quality, and alignment to claims workflows, system integrations, and compliance requirements prior to sprint commitment.
  • Applies project management disciplines to develop and maintain delivery plans, milestone tracking, dependency management, RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) logs, and governance activities across multiple AI initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and delivery timelines.
  • Provides advanced delivery oversight using metrics such as velocity, throughput, cycle time, flow efficiency, and unplanned work percentage to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities. Coaches stakeholders on the downstream impact of disrupting sprint commitments, supporting informed prioritization decisions at the leadership level.
  • Leads continuous improvement efforts beyond the team level by facilitating advanced retrospectives focused on delivery predictability, quality, collaboration effectiveness, and operational outcomes.   • Partners with business and technology leadership to support project governance activities, including executive status reporting, steering committee updates, decision tracking, and change management communications.

Experience

WORK ENVIRONMENT

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, you will be tasked with serving as a hands-on builder of SentinelOne's enterprise AI platform, including the Gateway, Harness, and Semantic Layers that every internal AI use case runs on top of. You will write the production code that governs, observes, secures, and scales AI activity across the company, working closely with the Sr. Director of Enterprise AI Platform Engineering and the rest of the platform team to take the architecture from design into running infrastructure.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Design, build, and operate components of the AI Gateway including centralized identity and authentication/authorization, token budgeting, DLP and content guardrails, multi-model routing and failover, MCP allow-listing, and request-level audit logging.
  • Build and maintain pieces of the Harness layer including agent orchestration (LangGraph or equivalent), prompt construction and context management, memory and state handling across multi-turn interactions, and model abstraction across providers such as AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex.
  • Develop and extend production services in Python (FastAPI) and pydantic.ai for LLM-powered components, and contribute to the React/TypeScript surfaces that expose platform capabilities to internal teams.
  • Implement MCP/tool wiring for internal and SaaS-embedded agents, ensuring every caller regardless of origin passes through the same policy controls.
  • Contribute to the Claude and Gemini Enterprise plugin framework by building, testing, and hardening role-based skills and agents, and help mature the pipeline for how plugins are authored, evaluated, and deployed.
  • Instrument the platform for observability including metrics, tracing, and audit trails, and participate in on-call and operational support for platform services.
  • Write clear technical documentation and participate in architecture and code reviews, holding a high bar for quality, security, and maintainability.
  • Partner with engineers across Enterprise Data, Enterprise Apps, Product Development, and Infosec to integrate the platform with governed data sources and shared architectural contracts.
  • Work with the Sr. Director and model evaluation tooling to help close the loop between evaluation results and model selection, prompt tuning, and routing decisions.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Hands-on experience building production services that sit in front of multiple consumers such as an API gateway, internal platform, or data platform, with real exposure to authentication/authorization, rate limiting, observability, or audit logging; direct AI and LLM platform experience is a strong plus but not required.
  • Practical experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph or equivalent) and calling hosted model providers such as AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex, with a working understanding of how context windows, memory, and tool-calling actually behave in production, not just conceptually.
  • 5 or more years of professional software engineering experience; with experience building or operating AI and ML infrastructure in a production environment.
  • Strong Python skills, ideally with FastAPI, and comfort picking up frameworks like pydantic.ai for LLM-powered components; working familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus.
  • Exposure to or curiosity about the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the challenges of governing tool access for agents operating across enterprise systems.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI deployments such as Claude Enterprise (Anthropic) or Gemini Enterprise is a plus, including how they are administered and how access and policy controls work.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals including clean, tested, production-grade code, strong API design skills, and the ability to give and receive feedback well in code and architecture reviews.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, still-forming platform environment where you are energized by ambiguity and enjoy turning a rough architecture into working, reliable infrastructure.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

  • Flexible time off

Work Perks & Flexibility

Wellness & Lifestyle

jobs.description:
Role : Associate Trust & Safety - Eaze

Work Location : Work From Home

Department : Eaze

Employment Type : 12 Months Contract

About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Associate – Trust & Safety (Eaze)

About Eaze :

Eaze is a platform dedicated to creating a safe, supportive, and judgment-free space where users can engage in meaningful conversations and build genuine human connections. Through voice and chat experiences, Eaze prioritizes user well-being by fostering a trusted, respectful, and secure community.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Associate – Trust & Safety to help maintain a safe and trusted experience for our users. In this role, you will review and moderate user interactions, enforce community guidelines, identify policy violations, and ensure a high standard of platform safety and quality.

Working closely with the Trust & Safety team, you will play a key role in protecting users, improving moderation processes, and upholding the integrity of the Eaze community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and moderate audio, chat, and user interactions in line with Eaze's community guidelines and safety policies.
  • Identify, investigate, and take appropriate action on abusive, harmful, fraudulent, or policy-violating content and behavior.
  • Escalate high-risk or sensitive cases to the relevant internal teams for timely resolution.
  • Review user reports, appeals, and flagged conversations to ensure fair and consistent moderation decisions.
  • Conduct quality audits of moderated conversations and maintain accurate moderation records.
  • Monitor moderation trends and provide insights to improve platform safety, policies, and user experience.
  • Collaborate with Product, Operations, Quality, and Trust & Safety teams to strengthen moderation processes.
  • Handle sensitive content with professionalism, empathy, and confidentiality while adhering to platform standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
  • 1–2 years of experience in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, Community Moderation, Quality Audit, Customer Support, or similar roles.
  • Strong understanding of online safety, community guidelines, and content moderation practices.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in English and Tamil (Read, Write & Speak mandatory).
  • Comfortable reviewing sensitive or emotionally challenging content while maintaining objectivity and professionalism.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, CRM tools, and moderation or ticketing platforms.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to make consistent moderation decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Trust & Safety operations for social, chat, voice, or community-based platforms.
  • Familiarity with moderation dashboards, QA tools, or ticketing systems.
  • Understanding of abuse detection, fraud prevention, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to handle sensitive situations with empathy and discretion.

Why Join Eaze?

  • Build a safer and more trusted digital community with meaningful user impact.
  • Work on large-scale Trust & Safety operations and help shape platform safety standards.
  • Gain hands-on experience in content moderation, policy enforcement, and community operations.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced startup environment with significant learning and growth opportunities.
  • Make a meaningful difference by fostering healthier, safer, and more respectful online interactions.

jobs.description:
Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform: that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

At SpotMe/Onomi, the Solution Architect reports to the Solutions Director and ensures seamless integration of SpotMe/Onomi within large enterprise ecosystems. Acting as both a customer-facing presales engineer and a post-sales integration leader, this role bridges business needs and technical execution. By advising on architecture, designing integration flows, and supporting implementation, the Solution Architect enables customers to maximize value from Onomi while driving continuous feedback into Product and Engineering.

This role is the ideal challenge for an experienced Solution Architect, Presales Engineer, or Integration Consultant in life sciences technology (SaaS) who thrives in dynamic environments and wants to be the technical bridge between global life sciences enterprises and the Onomi platform reshaping how they engage with physicians.

Role breakdown

20% Presales support & customer-facing architecture design

  • Partner with Sales to position Onomi’s capabilities, validate technical feasibility with customers, deliver technical presentations, and support RFP responses.
  • Lead customer discovery sessions to capture requirements, identify integration touchpoints, and translate them into high-level architectures.
  • Build trust with enterprise stakeholders by articulating the value, feasibility, and compliance of proposed solutions.

60% Post-sales solution design & implementation support

  • Produce detailed solution architecture documents, covering data flows, integration methods - APIs 2.0, SSO, internal connectors (Salesforce, Veeva apps etc…) and deliver iPaaS custom integrations setup - taking into account industry specific considerations.
  • Work alongside the Program Manager in delivering new and innovative solutions to customers in a data centric environment
  • Collaborate with internal teams building Product integration features to completion
  • Ensure solutions meet both technical and business requirements through close collaboration with SpotMe Program Managers, customers and partners with a diverse range of stakeholder responsibilities (IT, Business, Compliance etc…).

20% Post-integration support & product feedback

  • Act as escalation point for complex integration issues, working with engineering to resolve within SLA.
  • Capture lessons learned from enterprise projects and feed structured insights back to Product for roadmap prioritization.
  • Contribute to process improvements, templates, and best practices that raise integration quality and reduce recurring issues.
  • Actively maintain up-to-date technical documentation for enterprise customer solutions as they are implemented or updated.

Objectives – The problems you will solve

Within 3 Months

  • Platform: Get trained on the Onomi platform product and features, data model and administration
  • Business Acumen: Understanding a typical user journey and system flows for the various Onomi Use cases managed through our platform and how does this translate into potential communication with 3rd party systems
  • Sectorial: Familiarize yourself with life sciences CRM systems (Salesforce, Veeva, IQVIA, etc.), their common data models and integration requirements while grasping the compliance needs of the clients (data privacy, consent, audit trails, field force restrictions) if not part of a previous experience.
  • Technical: Shadow experienced Solution Architects to learn SpotMe/Onomi’s integration ecosystem and practices: APIs 2.0, SSO, internal connectors (Salesforce, Veeva apps etc…), iPaaS custom integrations setup
  • Methodology: Gain familiarity with the general methodology and various internal and external output needs such as customer documentation standards, and integration testing and deployment guidelines
  • Lead presales calls independently: present SpotMe/Onomi’s integration capabilities, outline high-level architectures, and respond to common integration questions.
  • Draft first Design Document for a customer integration project and achieve customer sign-off.
  • Successfully support sales in responding to at least one RFP.

Within 6 Months

  • Deliver and own enterprise integration projects end-to-end, from scoping to Integration Acceptance Testing (IAT) without supervision.
  • Provide first-line API 2.0 support to enterprise customers within SLA.
  • Build strong partnerships with Product & Engineering by documenting gaps, bugs, or enhancement requests and specifications for new or enhanced native integration modules.

Within 12 Months

  • Be recognized by Sales as a trusted presales partner, capable of influencing customer technical decisions.
  • Build and deliver architecture landscape evolution plans for enterprise customers expanding their SpotMe/Onomi integrations.
  • Be the go-to person to person for your team for feasibility assessments and to the company about the customer integrations that you delivered

What we are looking for

Integration & technical expertise

  • Solution Architect, Presales Engineer, or Integration Consultant roles (SaaS preferred) who worked in commercial/marketing applications: CRM, marketing automation
  • Strong technical foundation with hands-on experience in building integrations: REST APIs, JSON, SSO, ETL, iPaaS (e.g., Mulesoft, Workato).
  • Salesforce and/or Veeva integration expertise in life sciences/pharma is a strong plus: REST API, Apex, SOQL queries.

Business & industry acumen

  • Understanding of pharma compliance aspects: data privacy, consent, audit requirements, and compliance with field force usage is a plus.
  • Customer focused and solution-oriented, the ability to articulate technical concepts and their value in business outcomes
  • Ability to translate enterprise requirements and compliance constraints into scalable technical integration design and product improvements.

Customer-facing & communication skills

  • Proven experience in customer-facing technical roles: confident presenting, pitching, and negotiating with enterprise stakeholders.
  • Skilled at simplifying complex technical concepts and presenting them clearly to C-level and enterprise architects.
  • Experience running workshops to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, and integration challenges.
  • Ability to tailor demos and prototypes to resonate with different customer personas.

Languages

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); other languages are an asset.
